# Raymond A. Merriman: Comprehensive Research Report

## 1. Background, Education, and Career History

**Personal Details:**
- Born December 25, 1946
- Currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA
- Has been active in astrology since 1967 and in financial markets since 1978

**Education:**
- B.A. in Psychology, Michigan State University (1969)
- Post-graduate studies in Clinical Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University (1969-1971)

**Career Timeline:**
- 1967: First encountered astrology as a graduate student at Michigan State University
- 1972: Passed the AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) Professional Exam -- reportedly the youngest person ever to do so at the time
- 1972: Founded the Aquarian Revelation Center
- 1977: Founded Seek-It Publications
- 1978: Entered financial markets
- 1980: Became a student of Walter Bressert, a legendary commodities cycles analyst, in Tucson, Arizona
- 1981: Founded the Merriman Market Analyst (MMA)
- 1982: Published "The Gold Book," became a CTA registered with the NFA and CFTC; began publishing the MMA Cycles Report
- 1982-1986: Frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN)
- 1986-1987: Investment Executive at Prudential Securities
- 1987-1990: Investment Executive at Shearson Lehman Hutton (formerly E.F. Hutton)
- 1990-1994: Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures at Paine Webber
- 1994: Retired from Wall Street firms; began writing "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing"
- 2013: Founded the Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)

## 2. Main Theories and Methodologies

Merriman's approach is a fusion of three disciplines:

**A. Cycles Analysis (non-astrological)**
Borrowed from his mentor Walter Bressert, this is classical market cycle theory -- identifying repeating periodicities in price data. Every cycle contains smaller sub-cycles ("phases"). Understanding the hierarchy of cycles is foundational to his forecasting. His book "Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics" (1994) covers this discipline independently of astrology.

**B. Geocosmic Studies (astrological correlations)**
This is the distinctive layer. Merriman correlates planetary aspects (angular relationships between planets) to market cycle reversals. The core principle: the longer the planetary cycle involved, the longer the market trend it corresponds to. He studies aspects between the outer planets -- Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto -- and maps them to intermediate-term (1-2 year) and long-term (4+ year) market cycles. He also uses faster-moving solar/lunar combinations for short-term trading signals.

**C. Trend Analysis and Technical Analysis**
Conventional chart patterns, moving averages, and technical indicators supplement the timing derived from cycles and geocosmics.

**The Integration:**
Geocosmics alone tell you *when* a reversal is likely, but not the *direction*. Cycle phase analysis determines whether a reversal is more likely to be a crest or a trough. Technical analysis provides entry/exit prices. The three work together: geocosmic dates provide the "when," cycles provide the "which direction," and technical analysis provides the "where" (price targets).

Merriman prefers the term "forecast" over "prediction," emphasizing that he identifies time bands with the highest probability of cycle completion, not certainties.

He also deliberately uses the term "geocosmic" rather than "astrology" in financial contexts, acknowledging that "in the field of financial markets, it is not so easy to use the word astrology and get their attention."

**Financial Market Timing:**

## 4. MMA (Merriman Market Analyst) -- Organization and Services

**History:** Incorporated September 28, 1983, in Lansing, Michigan. Grew from 35 to 350 subscribers in its first year. Has been featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street.

**Services offered:**
- **MMA Cycles Report** -- Monthly advisory newsletter (issued 17 times/year), covering stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans. Used by banks, financial institutions, and individual traders worldwide since 1982.
- **Weekly and Daily Forecasts** -- For active traders. A free weekly column is publicly available.
- **Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs)** -- Proprietary dates identifying the highest-probability windows for market reversals, rated 1-3 stars.
- **Solar/Lunar App** -- Mobile app providing weighted value scores for daily solar/lunar combinations and their probability of correlating with market reversals.
- **Jupiter Transit Reports** -- Personalized reports ranking Jupiter transits to a trader's natal chart on a scale of -3 to +3 for trading favorability.
- **Personal Consultations** -- Via Zoom ($50/month for chart-based financial outlook) or phone/email ($295).
- **Webinars and Virtual Education**
- **Books and Annual Forecast publications**
- **Investment Retreats** -- E.g., the upcoming May 20-24, 2026 retreat at Lake Bled, Slovenia.

**Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA):** Founded 2013. A two-year training program consisting of 99 classes, competency tests, and seven major research projects. Graduates now serve as MMA analysts covering international markets, writing for the MMA Cycles Report and the MMTA International Cycles Report (ICR).

## 5. Track Record -- Notable Predictions

**Successes:**
- **2008 Financial Crisis:** As early as 1994, Merriman began warning of a major stock market decline and financial crisis in 2008, based primarily on the Saturn-Uranus 180-degree opposition forming at that time (a 45-year cycle). This prediction proved directionally correct.
- **2013 Market Timing Digest Award:** Won the Gold Star as "Best Market Timer of 2013" from Market Timing Digest (Amsterdam). He was the only contestant to correctly identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market.
- **2014 Market Timing Digest Award:** Won the Gold Star again, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.
- **Gold Trade Example:** Recommended going long gold at 1825 +/- 10 with a stop-loss below 1790. Gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week and rallied to 2152 within two months.
- A client testimonial claims 36 trades closed in one year with an 86% win rate using his methodology.

**Failures / Questionable Calls:**
- **2010 and 2014 Continued Bear Market:** After correctly calling 2008, Merriman expected further significant declines in 2010 and 2014 based on challenging Saturn-Uranus-Pluto aspects. These did not materialize, as unprecedented central bank intervention (QE) drove markets to record highs. He attributed this to policy intervention "nullifying" the astrological signals -- critics view this as post-hoc rationalization.

**Important Caveats:**
- The track record claims come primarily from Merriman's own website and marketing materials, including cherry-picked trade examples and client testimonials.
- No independent, third-party audits or systematic verifications of his overall prediction accuracy have been found in the public record.
- The Market Timing Digest awards, while external, are from a niche publication, not a mainstream financial authority.

## 6. Specific Techniques -- Planetary Cycles and Application

**Long-Term Planetary Cycles:**
- **Jupiter-Saturn Conjunction (~20-year cycle):** The "Great Mutation" cycle. The 2000 conjunction at 22 degrees Taurus (square Uranus in Aquarius) coincided with the dot-com crash. These conjunctions cycle through zodiac elements (fire, earth, air, water) over ~200-year periods.
- **Saturn-Uranus (~45-year cycle):** The opposition phase (2008-2010) correlated with the financial crisis. The waning sextile phase (April 2025-January 2026) is currently being studied.
- **Saturn-Neptune (~36-year cycle):** Particularly significant for grain markets.
- **Jupiter-Uranus, Saturn-Pluto, Neptune-Pluto, Uranus-Pluto:** All studied in Volume 2 for correlations to 50-week or greater market cycles going back to 1789.

**Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs):**
- Calculated as the midpoint between the first and last geocosmic signature in a "cluster" (where no more than 6 calendar days separate consecutive signatures).
- Rated 1-3 stars: 3-star dates have at least two "Level 1" signatures within 4 calendar days. A Level 1 signature has at least 66% historical correlation to a primary cycle reversal within 12 trading days.

**Solar/Lunar Methodology (Short-Term):**
- Every Sun-Moon sign combination (e.g., Sun in Aries, Moon in Scorpio) is scored by historical correlation to 4%+ price reversals in the DJIA, NASDAQ, and Nikkei over 60 years of daily data.
- Weighted Value (WV) scoring: WV of 138+ is "higher than norm," 160+ is "very high." Below 83 suggests low reversal probability. About 30 high-probability 1-2 day reversal windows are identified per year per index.
- Trading setup: On a high-WV solar/lunar day, look for the price to exceed the prior day's high or low, then confirm with an "isolated high" or "isolated low" the following day.

**Planetary Ingresses and Stations:**
- A planet changing signs (ingress) is considered nearly as significant as aspects.
- Retrograde/direct stations of planets are also mapped to market reversals.

**Current Focus (2025-2026):**
- Pluto in Aquarius (for ~20 years), Neptune entering Aries, Uranus entering Gemini (July 2025) -- all three outer planets changing signs within two years, something that hasn't happened in 300 years. Merriman calls this the "Aries Vortex" and the midpoint of the "New Aira" (2020-2032).

## 9. Criticism and Controversies

**Scientific and Methodological Criticisms:**

1. **No plausible physical mechanism:** There is no known physical force by which planetary positions could influence stock prices, interest rates, or commodity prices. Proponents speak of "energies" or "vibrations" without measurable scientific definitions.

2. **Pseudoscience classification:** Financial astrology is classified as pseudoscience by the scientific community. Astrology has been rejected for having no explanatory power. Karl Popper cited astrology as his primary example of pseudoscience, and the most rigorous test (Shawn Carlson's double-blind study) found astrology performed no better than chance.

3. **Confirmation bias:** Critics argue that practitioners selectively highlight successful predictions while ignoring failures. Trading community discussions (e.g., Trade2Win forums) repeatedly raise the question: "How many reversals has he called that didn't work?"

4. **Post-hoc rationalization:** Merriman's explanation that central bank intervention "nullified" the astrological signals for 2010 and 2014 is seen as classic unfalsifiable reasoning -- if the prediction works, astrology is validated; if it fails, an external factor is blamed.

5. **Vague and unfalsifiable claims:** Forecasts often identify broad "time bands" rather than specific dates and directions, making rigorous backtesting difficult. The use of probabilities and ranges provides built-in protection against being definitively wrong.

6. **Cherry-picked evidence:** Track record claims come primarily from self-reported data, client testimonials, and selected trade examples. No independent audit of overall performance has been published.

7. **Survivorship and selection bias in research:** Studying 200+ years of planetary aspects against market data with many possible combinations creates a high risk of finding spurious correlations through data mining.

8. **Contradicts established financial theory:** The Efficient Market Hypothesis holds that all available information is already priced in. If planetary positions were genuinely predictive, the information would be arbitraged away.

9. **Rare events problem:** Some planetary configurations (e.g., specific outer planet conjunctions) occur only once in a lifetime, providing essentially no statistical sample from which to draw reliable conclusions.

**Merriman's Responses to Critics:**
- He argues that financial astrology is inherently falsifiable (unlike natal astrology), because specific market predictions can be checked against actual outcomes.
- He dismisses critics who cite the precession of equinoxes as showing "the critic's ignorance of the mechanics used in astrology."
- He points to his Market Timing Digest awards as objective validation.
- He acknowledges that geocosmics alone cannot forecast direction -- they only identify timing windows. This built-in limitation makes the system harder to definitively falsify.

## Summary Assessment

Raymond Merriman occupies a unique niche: he is arguably the only person who has held both legitimate Wall Street credentials (CTA, Series 3/7, positions at Prudential, E.F. Hutton, Paine Webber) and the highest leadership positions in the astrological community (ISAR president, Regulus Lifetime Achievement). However, the broader field of financial astrology remains classified as pseudoscience by the scientific community, with no plausible mechanism, no independent audits of overall track records, and significant risks of confirmation bias and data mining in the underlying research methodology.

## Early Life & Education

Raymond A. Merriman is an American professional astrologer since 1968, a publisher, author, and commodities specialist. Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

## Career in Financial Markets

His introduction to financial markets began in 1978. Two years later, he became a student of Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst in commodities from Tucson, Arizona. Under Walter's tutelage, Merriman began his research in the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, which resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles" in 1982. This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

He founded the Aquarian Revelation Center in 1972, Seek-It Publications in 1977, and the Merriman Market Analyst in 1981. In 2013, he created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology. At present, several of the graduates are now market analysts with MMA, analyzing various international markets.

## Publications & Books

Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Volumes 1–5 (1997–2012); *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982); *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006); *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015); and the annual *Forecast Book* (since 1976).

He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

At UAC (United Astrology Congress) 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award." He also served as president of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR) in 1994–2000, 2002–2008, and 2015–2017.

## Astrology Credentials

Raymond Merriman has served the astrological community for over 50 years. He passed the AFA Professional Astrological exam in 1972, at the time (and maybe still), the youngest person ever to do so. He is a Professional (Certified) Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972), as well as through ISAR, the International Society of Astrological Research (2000).

Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

## About Raymond Merriman

Raymond Merriman is the President of Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. ### Background & Career

The story of MMA began in 1980 in Tucson, Arizona when Raymond Merriman was introduced to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst and researcher, and began the study of cycles related to commodities and financial futures. By March 1982, Merriman had uncovered over 60 correlations to Gold prices, which were published in "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles," the first quantitative research effort on the correlation of planetary studies related to financial markets.

In 1994, he retired from the Wall Street firms as a Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures at Paine Webber, Inc., and began to write *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which would become a five-volume book series. This series took 17 years to complete and in total contained over 1,600 pages of research studies and conclusions.

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972.

### Company History

The Merriman Market Analyst was incorporated on September 28, 1983, at 2:30 PM, in Lansing, Michigan. After one year, the MMA Cycles Report grew from 35 to 350 subscribers, MMA was incorporated, and Merriman became a CTA registered with the National Futures Association (NFA) and the Commodities Future Trading Commission (CFTC).

## MMA's Methodology

Through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, MMA provides resources and education to help traders make informed decisions and take control of their financial future. They prefer the word "forecast" to "prediction," because the word forecast refers to probabilities. At present, several of the graduates are now market analysts with MMA, analyzing various international markets for "The MMA Cycles Report" as well as "The MMTA International Cycles Report" (ICR).

## Awards & Recognition

As featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street, Merriman Market Analyst is the leader in market timing products and services. In 1995, he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012, he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

Raymond Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA. You can learn more at [mmacycles.com](https://www.mmacycles.com/).

Here is a comprehensive overview of Raymond Merriman's planetary cycles and stock market methodology:

## Raymond Merriman – Planetary Cycles & Stock Market Methodology

### Background

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

### Origins of His Methodology

His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles' analyst. Under Walter's tutelage, Merriman began his research on the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, based on Walter's methodology of cycles analysis, which resulted in the publication of *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* in 1982 (out-of-print). This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

### Core Methodology

The central idea behind Merriman's approach is that planetary alignments correspond to reversals in financial market trends. The idea is that when certain planets are in one of these aspects to one another, trends in financial markets reverse. The longer the planetary cycle involved, the longer the market trend underway will culminate or end – and a new one will begin.

His methodology integrates multiple analytical tools: his arsenal seamlessly integrates Cycles, Geocosmic Signatures, and Trend Analysis patterns. This five volume set covers all of these factors in one of the most comprehensive studies ever conducted utilizing geocosmic, cycles, pattern recognition, trend analysis and technical analysis studies.

### The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing (5-Volume Series)

This is Merriman's magnum opus, written between 1997 and 2012:

- **Volume 1: Cycles and Patterns in the Indexes** – This covers cycles – their patterns and periodicities – as applied to 200+ years of daily, weekly, and/or monthly data, covering short-term, intermediate-term, and long-term cycles. This book contains no geocosmic studies, but is the basis for the future volumes which do utilize geocosmic studies that correlate with these market cycles.

- **Volume 2: Geocosmic Correlations to Investment Cycles** – This volume analyzes and gives weighted values (scores) to each long-term planetary cycle, its phases (aspects), and their correlation to 50-week or greater cycles in the U.S. stock market going all the way back to 1789. It examines which planetary cycles correlate with the 18-year and greater stock market cycles, which correlate more with the four-year cycles, and which correlate with long-term cycle crests versus troughs.

- **Volume 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles** – In this book, Raymond Merriman examines the correlations of all the major planetary aspects, and all the direct and retrograde planetary stations, to tradable cycles in the U.S. stock indexes (Dow Jones Industrial Averages and S&P futures). These correlations are then segregated according to their consistency of occurrence, as well as their strength in price changes, resulting in rankings of Levels 1, 2 and 3. They are also ranked according to their percent of correlation to primary, intermediate-term, and longer-term cycles.

- **Volume 4: Solar-Lunar Correlations to Short-Term Trading Cycles** – This is a book for the short-term trader of stock market indices.

- **Volume 5: Price Targets** – The previous 4 volumes focused on "when" to buy and sell. This last volume addresses "where" to buy and sell, or at what price. It is the art and science of "forecasting price targets" and details the mathematical formulas and technical studies used to enhance timing of entry and exit.

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

### Key Planetary Relationships Studied

Volume 2 correlates all geocosmic signatures involving major aspect relationships between Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto, to the intermediate and longer-term cycles in the U.S. stock market. This book not only shows the historical correspondence of long-term planetary cycles to long-term cycles in the U.S. Stock Market, but also provides an excellent model for investing based upon this knowledge.

### Recognition

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### The Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)

In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. The original graduates have been trained to become financial market analysts utilizing the MMA methodology. At present, several of the original graduates write monthly market analysis reports for the MMA Cycles Report as well as the Monthly International Cycles Reports.

In summary, Merriman's methodology is a unique blend of traditional market cycles analysis, geocosmic (planetary) correlations, pattern recognition, and technical analysis, aimed at identifying the timing of major reversals in financial markets—particularly U.S. stock indices, gold, silver, and other commodities.

## Raymond Merriman and Financial Astrology: Criticism & Skepticism

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Ray Merriman is one of the more well-known financial astrologers in the astrological community, and he served as the president of the International Society for Astrological Research. He started in astrology in 1967, when he first came across the subject while a graduate student at Michigan State University. In 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam as the "Best Market Timer of 2013," being the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market. In 2014, he received the same award again, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates.

### Skeptical Criticism of Financial Astrology

One of the criticisms or attacks that skeptics have about astrology is that it's not falsifiable, or that astrologers make non-falsifiable statements that can't be proved one way or another. However, proponents of financial astrology argue this is one branch where that's demonstrably not true, since on a daily basis, specific statements about anticipated outcomes from certain configurations are made.

### Merriman's Response to Critics

In his writings, Merriman directly addresses scientific criticism. He notes that as students proceed with the study of astrology, they will hear so-called "scientists" who use the precession of equinoxes as a reason why astrology cannot work. He argues such criticism "says nothing about astrology, but instead only shows the critic's ignorance of the mechanics used in astrology."

### Trading Community Debate

The Trade2Win forum thread illustrates the polarized debate around Merriman's work. A poster noted that after seeing a thread on financial astrology ridiculed, they shared a piece from Raymond Merriman, who had been calling a potential top in equities around the key cycle date of July 27. Skeptical traders responded by questioning how many reversals he had called in the past, asking whether followers only keep a record of successes. This highlights the common criticism of **confirmation bias** — the concern that practitioners may selectively highlight hits while ignoring misses.

Another forum participant referenced the book *Fooled by Randomness*, which touches on correlation and chance, though they also noted that the astrological correlations "have proved a consistent correlation, so if something works then it's worth looking at (no matter how crazy it appears)."

### The 2008 Financial Crisis Prediction

As early as 1994, Merriman began warning that a huge stock market decline and financial crisis would occur in 2008. His prediction was largely based on the angular relationship between transiting Saturn and Uranus — a 180-degree opposition aspect. However, he admits he expected more bad news in 2010 and 2014 due to challenging aspects between Saturn, Uranus, and Pluto, but the largest market intervention in world history by central bank policymakers nullified this possibility. Critics note this kind of post-hoc rationalization — explaining away failed predictions by citing external factors — is a common issue with astrological forecasting.

### Merriman's Bold Claims

When asked about the growing interest in financial astrology, Merriman has stated: "It works! Nothing is as consistently accurate in identifying reversal times in financial markets as astrology." Such claims naturally draw skepticism from mainstream financial analysts and scientists who see no plausible mechanism by which planetary positions could influence market behavior.

### Summary

The debate around Merriman and financial astrology centers on several key skeptical arguments: the lack of a scientifically plausible mechanism, concerns about confirmation bias and selective reporting of successes, post-hoc rationalization of failed predictions, and the broader scientific consensus that astrology has no empirical basis. Supporters counter that the track record speaks for itself and that correlations in market timing data are statistically significant.

## Raymond Merriman's 2008 Financial Crisis Prediction

As early as 1994, financial astrologer Ray Merriman began persistently warning anyone within earshot that a huge stock market decline and financial crisis would upset the global economic applecart in 2008.

### The Astrological Basis: Saturn-Uranus Opposition

While there were other astrological factors to consider, Merriman says his prediction was largely based on the angular relationship between transiting Saturn and Uranus – a 180-degree opposition aspect that would be forming in the heavens at this time.

In Merriman's framework:
- Financial astrologers view Saturn's role as defender of the status quo.
- Among other things, antsy Uranus represents the irresistible urge to break away and try something new.

### Historical Pattern with Pluto

In the past, when this particular celestial standoff has occurred at the same time planet Pluto is transiting in one of what astrologers call the Cardinal signs (Aries, Libra, Cancer and Capricorn), the event has coincided with troubling news for the banking and investment communities.

### The Timeline of the Opposition

This was the 4th of 5 passes of the 45-year opposition between Saturn and Uranus. The first passage was November 4, 2008. Saturn was in opposition to Uranus from 2008 to 2010.

### Concerns Beyond 2008

Merriman admits he worried that "hard" or challenging aspects between slow-moving Saturn, Uranus and Pluto would be forming again in 2010 and 2014. The expectation was that more bad news might be on the way, but the largest market intervention in world history by central bank policymakers nullified this possibility. The Fed lowered interest rates and later began buying Treasuries and mortgage-backed securities in an effort to stimulate spending and economic growth. With help like this the stock market was able to soar to record highs.

### Merriman's Background

Ray Merriman has worked as a consultant in finance since the 1980s, providing investment advice and financial trend forecasting. The author of nearly 50 books, Merriman writes the monthly Merriman Market Analyst newsletter (MMA Cycles) and both a weekly and daily forecast for more active traders. He served as President of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR) between 1994 and 2000 – and again between 2002 and 2008.

It's worth noting that Merriman's predictions are rooted in financial astrology, which is not considered a scientifically validated method of financial forecasting. While his 2008 prediction proved directionally correct, this approach lacks the empirical rigor of conventional economic analysis.

Here's a comprehensive overview of financial astrology, the scientific evidence (or lack thereof), and the criticisms leveled against it:

## Financial Astrology: Scientific Evidence & Criticism

### What Is Financial Astrology?

Financial astrology, also known as economic astrology or astro-economics, is a pseudoscientific practice that correlates celestial bodies' movements with events in financial markets. It's an offshoot of traditional astrology, which seeks to interpret the influence of planetary positions over everyday life. Financial astrologers believe that these cosmic patterns can predict market trends, economic cycles, and even individual investment success.

### Historical Roots

The use of astrology for financial purposes dates back thousands of years. Ancient civilizations, such as the Babylonians and Egyptians, used astrology to make decisions related to agriculture, trade, and resource management. In modern times, financial astrology gained recognition through the work of W.D. Gann, a successful trader and analyst who combined astrological insights with technical analysis to predict market movements. Gann's success brought financial astrology into the spotlight.

### Lack of Scientific Evidence

There's absolutely no scientific proof that it works. It's all based on beliefs, not facts.

Astrology has been rejected by the scientific community for having no explanatory power for describing the universe. Scientific testing has found no evidence to support the premises or purported effects outlined in the astrological traditions. Where astrology has made falsifiable predictions, it has been falsified.

The most famous test was headed by Shawn Carlson and included a committee of scientists and a committee of astrologers. It led to the conclusion that natal astrology performed no better than chance.

### Key Criticisms

1. **No Plausible Mechanism:** What physical force, transmitted across the vast emptiness of space, allows Mars's position to influence the earnings report of Apple Inc. or the price of Crude Oil? Proponents often talk of "vibrations" or "energies," but these terms have no measurable, scientific definition in this context. Without a plausible cause, the entire premise seems to collapse under the weight of basic physics.

2. **Vague and Unfalsifiable Claims:** A hallmark of pseudoscience is that its predictions are often so broad and ambiguous that they can be interpreted to fit almost any outcome. A forecast for "increased volatility in the technology sector" or "potential for sudden moves in cryptocurrencies" is nearly impossible to prove wrong. The market is inherently volatile. A specific, falsifiable prediction like "The Nifty 50 will close at 22,500 on May 15th" is rarely, if ever, made. This vagueness protects the astrologer from accountability and makes rigorous back-testing nearly impossible.

3. **Hindsight Bias:** Skeptics argue that these predictions often rely on hindsight bias, making it challenging to separate genuine foresight from coincidence. "It's easy to connect astrological cycles to market events in hindsight," said a financial analyst. "But when it comes to forecasting future events, financial astrology lacks the rigorous testing and validation that other models undergo."

4. **Confirmation Bias:** Another criticism is the potential for psychological bias. Believers in financial astrology might experience confirmation bias, selectively noticing instances where astrological predictions align with market movements while ignoring contradictory evidence. This bias can lead to misguided investment decisions.

5. **Pattern-Seeking Behavior:** The human tendency to find patterns, even where none exist, could explain why some traders believe they see correlations between celestial events and market fluctuations.

6. **Contradicts Established Financial Theory:** Critics argue that there is no scientific basis for astrological predictions and that financial markets are influenced by tangible economic factors rather than cosmic events. The Efficient Market Hypothesis, which assumes that all available information is already reflected in asset prices, contradicts the idea that celestial events could impact market movements.

7. **Rare Events Problem:** Critics have pointed out that some astrological events that have been used in predictions occur so rarely that they may have never happened before within a human lifetime, thus having no precedent on which to predict results.

### Philosophical Classification as Pseudoscience

Astrology provides the quintessential example of a pseudoscience since it has been tested repeatedly and failed all the tests. Using the criterion of falsifiability, astrology is a pseudoscience. Astrology was Popper's most frequent example of pseudoscience. Popper regarded astrology as "pseudo-empirical" in that "it appeals to observation and experiment", but "nevertheless does not come up to scientific standards".

The philosopher Thomas Kuhn argued that it was not lack of falsifiability that makes astrology unscientific, but rather that the process and concepts of astrology are non-empirical.

### One Notable Academic Finding

Surprisingly, there's some academic research on moon cycles moving the markets. A 2006 study by University of Michigan economists found a correlation between full moons and lower stock returns in a 48-country portfolio. The study found stock returns are notably lower in the days surrounding a full moon compared to those around a new moon. This difference in returns amounts to 3-5 percent annually across both equal-weighted and value-weighted global portfolios. However, correlation does not imply causation, and critics argue that correlations between celestial events and financial outcomes are often coincidental, lacking empirical evidence to support causation. The challenge lies in differentiating between legitimate patterns and spurious correlations.

### Industry Stance

Large financial firms tend to ignore financial astrology. The practice was used by Goldman Sachs in a paper released in 1999, focusing specifically on the correlation between eclipses and the state of the financial market at that time.

### Bottom Line

If you rely solely on astrology for your investments, you could miss out on some great opportunities or lose all your money. And if things don't go as planned, it can really shake your confidence. So, while it might be interesting to read about, financial astrology isn't a reliable way to build your wealth.

## Raymond Merriman: Influence in Financial Astrology

### Background and Credentials

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. His formal education and training includes a bachelor's degree in psychology (Michigan State University, 1969), postgraduate studies in clinical psychology, professional (certified) life member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972), commodities trading advisor (CTA, 1982), and series 3 and 7 exams for commodities, financial futures, securities and investments.

Raymond Merriman has served the astrological community for over 50 years. He passed the AFA Professional Astrological exam in 1972, at the time (and maybe still) the youngest person ever to do so. He served as ISAR president 1994–2000, 2002–2008, and 2015–2017.

### Awards and Recognition

In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### Leadership in the Astrological Community

He also served seven non-consecutive terms as President of ISAR (the International Society for Astrological Research), a decision reached in a two-step process involving over 1500 members from over 25 national centers around the world, not least in part due to his participation in helping formulate the certification criteria back in the mid-1990's, which has since resulted in this model being viewed as the international standard for astrological professionalism.

Merriman's contributions and awards in astrology are numerous and include: president of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR; 1995–2001); recipient of the Aquarius Workshops Award for "Service to Astrology" (1994); recipient of Professional Astrologers Inc. (PAI) Award for "Outstanding Activities on Behalf of Furthering Goals of Astrology—Lectures."

### His Business and Methodology

Merriman is president of the Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., an investment advisory firm specializing in market timing products and services. He is the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory newsletter issued 17 times a year, and used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1982.

Merriman Market Analyst combines decades of expertise with innovative tools to give investors a unique edge in navigating financial markets. Through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, they provide resources and education to help traders make informed decisions and take control of their financial future.

### Community and Followers

Ray is the author of 27 books on astrology. His journey spans from pioneering evolutionary astrology to becoming a leading figure in financial astrology.

The people he teaches at his Merriman Market Timing Academy are "doing incredible studies" and "doing the things that I can't do because only one of me." He noted, "I got 100 of them working on it, and it's amazing what we're finding out."

The original graduates have been trained to become financial market analysts utilizing the MMA methodology. At present, several of the original graduates write monthly market analysis reports for the MMA Cycles Report as well as the Monthly International Cycles Reports.

Community members on Astrology Weekly have started threads about financial astrology specifically to discuss Merriman's annual forecast books. He has been featured on The Astrology Podcast, where he specializes in financial astrology, including the use of astrology to time changes in financial markets.

### Use of the Term "Geocosmic"

Merriman has noted that "in the field of financial markets, it is not so easy to use the word astrology and get their attention," which is why he often uses the term "geocosmic" rather than "astrology" when addressing financial professionals.

Raymond Merriman is clearly one of the most influential and recognized figures in the niche of financial astrology, with a career spanning over five decades, extensive publications, prestigious awards, and an active community of followers and students around the world.

## Raymond Merriman's Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates & Solar/Lunar Methodology

### Background

Merriman's introduction to financial markets began in 1978. Two years later, he became a student of Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst in commodities. Under Walter's tutelage, Merriman began his research in the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, based on Walter's methodology of cycles analysis, which resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles" in 1982. This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

### What Are "Geocosmic Signatures"?

The aspects between planets is what Merriman primarily means when he uses the term "Geocosmic studies." To determine those times of aspects, one needs to know the signs of the zodiac, which enables calculation of the distance between any two planets. The key geocosmic elements include:

- Aspects, ingresses, and stations — these bypass the need for individual horoscopes and go directly to what matters for market timing.
- Major aspects include: Conjunction (0°), Square (90°), Trine (120°), and Opposition (180°).

### How Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs) Are Calculated

The dates themselves are midpoints in time between the first and last signature of a "cluster" of signatures. In a cluster, no more than 6 calendar days separate any two consecutive signatures.

Merriman examines the correlations of all the major planetary aspects, and all the direct and retrograde planetary stations, to trade cycles in the U.S. stock indexes. These correlations are then segregated according to their consistency of occurrence, as well as their strength in price changes, resulting in rankings of Levels 1, 2, and 3. They are also ranked according to their percent of correlation to primary, intermediate-term, and longer-term cycles.

#### Star Ratings

- A date followed by three (3) stars means these periods have the highest probability of correlating to primary cycles in various financial markets, according to historical studies.
- Two or three-star critical reversal dates means there is at least one geocosmic signature nearby that is a "Level One" type. A Level One signature has the highest correlation to a primary cycle within up to 12 trading days, with a correlation of at least 66%. In order for a critical reversal date to merit three stars, there are usually at least two Level 1 type signatures within 4 calendar days.

### Solar/Lunar Methodology (Short-Term Trading)

The book's hypothesis is that short-term traders can take advantage of specific reversal dates during the year that can be identified by using specific solar/lunar combinations.

Volume 4 is the most comprehensive analysis of all the Sun-Moon combinations and their correspondence to price movements in stock indices. It examines 60 years of daily data on the Dow Jones Industrial Averages, and the past 16-18 years of daily data on the NASDAQ Composite and Japanese Nikkei stock indices. The probability of 4% or greater reversals is assigned to each Sun-Moon combination, which are usually in effect 1-2 (sometimes 3) trading days per year. In all, there are approximately 30 of these 1-2 day periods that stand out as high probability trade dates each year, in each index. Thus when a Sun-Moon combination with a high correlation to 4% or greater price swings is in effect, a trader knows that this 1-2 day period offers a high probability for an isolated low or high to form, from which the market will reverse a substantial amount in a very short time.

The book also identifies which Sun-Moon combinations have a much lower than expected correlation to short-term trading reversals. In addition, each Sun-Mercury and Sun-Venus sign combinations are examined for high and low probability reversal zones.

### The Weighted Value (WV) Scoring System

The MMA Solar/Lunar App uses a weighted value scoring system:

- A weighted value of 138 or higher is most desirable. Anything over 114 should be considered "higher than norm." Above 138 is "high." Above 160 is "very high." The higher the score, the more frequent it has correlated with a reversal in the past.
- When a solar/lunar value is grey, it means the historical frequency of this solar/lunar combination for a reversal is low. The lower the score, the less frequently it has coincided with a reversal of 3% in Gold and DJIA or 4% in Silver. One should not look for an important isolated low or high if those scores are below 83, and especially if below 50.

### Trading Setup for Solar/Lunar Reversals

When entering a solar/lunar reversal zone, the next step in the setup is to see the price take out the low or high of the previous day. If it takes out the high, you are looking for a reversal down ("picking a top"). If it takes out the low, you are looking for a reversal up ("picking a bottom"). The setup is confirmed when the next day's price is lower than the prior day's high (isolated high) or higher than the prior day's low (isolated low). An isolated high is a day in which the high is higher than the day before and day after. An isolated low is a day in which the low is lower than the day before and day after. The goal is to identify isolated lows or highs on solar/lunar days with high weighted value scores.

### Important Caveats

A common misconception about Financial Astrology, or Geocosmic Studies, is that these studies provide "fortune-telling" qualities. If one knows astrology, the misconception is that one knows the future. Astrology, or Geocosmic Studies, by itself, does not have that capability.

Geocosmics alone cannot tell you what the trend is. And when a critical reversal hits, you never know whether the reversal will be a correction to the longer-term trend, or the start of an entirely new underlying trend. To understand the underlying trend, one has to understand the nature of cycles, and the patterns that form within each cycle. Within every cycle are smaller cycles, or "phases" — this is the only understanding that provides the ability to accurately forecast whether a future critical reversal date is more likely to be a crest or a trough.

### Awards and Recognition

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market.

### Key Resources

Merriman's methodology is taught through MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a 2-year instructional program on integrating the principles of cycles analysis, geocosmic studies, trend analysis, and technical analysis for the purpose of becoming a financial market timer.

## Raymond Merriman — Overview

### Professional Astrology Background

Merriman is well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972.

He is a Professional (Certified) Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972), as well as through ISAR, the International Society of Astrological Research (2000).

### ISAR Presidency

He served as president of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR) in 1994-2000, 2002-2008, and 2015-2017. Merriman has served the astrological community for over 50 years, including as the longest serving president of ISAR.

He served seven non-consecutive terms as President of ISAR, a decision reached in a two-step process involving over 1500 members from over 25 national centers around the world, not least in part due to his participation in helping formulate the certification criteria back in the mid-1990's, which has since resulted in this model being viewed as the international standard for astrological professionalism.

### ISAR Accomplishments

As ISAR President, he worked with a group that challenged each other to build something for astrology. During his terms, ISAR grew from one of the smallest national/international astrology organizations to one of the largest and most active. Highlights included the creation of a certification program, a consulting skills program, a competency exam, and the ISAR online e-zine.

### Financial Market Career — CTA & NFA Registration

He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. He has been a CTA registered with the National Futures Association since 1982.

Merriman is a Commodity Trading Advisor (CTA) and passed both the Series 3 (Commodities) and Series 7 (Securities) exams while working as an analyst at E.F. Hutton in the 1980s. He is a member of the National Futures Association (NFA) and served as an arbitrator in disputes for several years.

### Professional Roles

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

Between 1982-1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).

### Awards

In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

### Education

Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971.

Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

# Raymond A. Merriman: Comprehensive Research Report

## 1. Background, Education, and Career History

**Personal Details:**
- Born December 25, 1946
- Currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA
- Has been active in astrology since 1967 and in financial markets since 1978

**Education:**
- B.A. in Psychology, Michigan State University (1969)
- Post-graduate studies in Clinical Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University (1969-1971)

**Career Timeline:**
- 1967: First encountered astrology as a graduate student at Michigan State University
- 1972: Passed the AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) Professional Exam -- reportedly the youngest person ever to do so at the time
- 1972: Founded the Aquarian Revelation Center
- 1977: Founded Seek-It Publications
- 1978: Entered financial markets
- 1980: Became a student of Walter Bressert, a legendary commodities cycles analyst, in Tucson, Arizona
- 1981: Founded the Merriman Market Analyst (MMA)
- 1982: Published "The Gold Book," became a CTA registered with the NFA and CFTC; began publishing the MMA Cycles Report
- 1982-1986: Frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN)
- 1986-1987: Investment Executive at Prudential Securities
- 1987-1990: Investment Executive at Shearson Lehman Hutton (formerly E.F. Hutton)
- 1990-1994: Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures at Paine Webber
- 1994: Retired from Wall Street firms; began writing "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing"
- 2013: Founded the Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)

---

## 2. Main Theories and Methodologies

Merriman's approach is a fusion of three disciplines:

**A. Cycles Analysis (non-astrological)**
Borrowed from his mentor Walter Bressert, this is classical market cycle theory -- identifying repeating periodicities in price data. Every cycle contains smaller sub-cycles ("phases"). Understanding the hierarchy of cycles is foundational to his forecasting. His book "Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics" (1994) covers this discipline independently of astrology.

**B. Geocosmic Studies (astrological correlations)**
This is the distinctive layer. Merriman correlates planetary aspects (angular relationships between planets) to market cycle reversals. The core principle: the longer the planetary cycle involved, the longer the market trend it corresponds to. He studies aspects between the outer planets -- Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto -- and maps them to intermediate-term (1-2 year) and long-term (4+ year) market cycles. He also uses faster-moving solar/lunar combinations for short-term trading signals.

**C. Trend Analysis and Technical Analysis**
Conventional chart patterns, moving averages, and technical indicators supplement the timing derived from cycles and geocosmics.

**The Integration:**
Geocosmics alone tell you *when* a reversal is likely, but not the *direction*. Cycle phase analysis determines whether a reversal is more likely to be a crest or a trough. Technical analysis provides entry/exit prices. The three work together: geocosmic dates provide the "when," cycles provide the "which direction," and technical analysis provides the "where" (price targets).

Merriman prefers the term "forecast" over "prediction," emphasizing that he identifies time bands with the highest probability of cycle completion, not certainties.

He also deliberately uses the term "geocosmic" rather than "astrology" in financial contexts, acknowledging that "in the field of financial markets, it is not so easy to use the word astrology and get their attention."

---

## 3. Key Publications and Books

**Financial Market Timing:**
1. **"The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles"** (1982) -- The first quantitative study correlating planetary cycles to a financial market. Now out of print.
2. **"The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing"** -- Five-volume series (1997-2012), over 1,600 pages, his magnum opus:
   - Vol. 1: Cycles and Patterns in the Indexes (200+ years of data, no astrology)
   - Vol. 2: Geocosmic Correlations to Investment Cycles (long-term planetary cycles mapped to 50-week+ market cycles from 1789 onward)
   - Vol. 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles (all major planetary aspects ranked by correlation strength to tradable cycles in DJIA/S&P)
   - Vol. 4: Solar/Lunar Correlations to Short-Term Trading Cycles (60 years of daily data, ~30 high-probability reversal dates per year per index)
   - Vol. 5: Price Targets (mathematical formulas for "where" to buy/sell)
3. **"Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics"** (1994) -- Classic primer on cycle studies, no astrology content
4. **"The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market: Secrets of a Silver Trader"** (2006) -- Moon transit correlations to silver prices
5. **"Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader"** (2015)
6. **"Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing"** -- Textbook on reading an ephemeris and applying geocosmic correlations
7. **Annual Forecast Book** -- Published continuously since 1976 (now in its 50th edition for 2026). Covers financial markets, world economy, and political trends.

**Astrology (non-financial):**
8. **"Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope"** (1977)
9. **"Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through States of Consciousness"** (1992)
10. **"The Solar Return Book of Prediction"** (1977, revised edition available)

His works have been translated into German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, and English. He has approximately 33 books listed on Goodreads.

## 4. MMA (Merriman Market Analyst) -- Organization and Services

**History:** Incorporated September 28, 1983, in Lansing, Michigan. Grew from 35 to 350 subscribers in its first year. Has been featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street.

**Services offered:**
- **MMA Cycles Report** -- Monthly advisory newsletter (issued 17 times/year), covering stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans. Used by banks, financial institutions, and individual traders worldwide since 1982.
- **Weekly and Daily Forecasts** -- For active traders. A free weekly column is publicly available.
- **Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs)** -- Proprietary dates identifying the highest-probability windows for market reversals, rated 1-3 stars.
- **Solar/Lunar App** -- Mobile app providing weighted value scores for daily solar/lunar combinations and their probability of correlating with market reversals.
- **Jupiter Transit Reports** -- Personalized reports ranking Jupiter transits to a trader's natal chart on a scale of -3 to +3 for trading favorability.
- **Personal Consultations** -- Via Zoom ($50/month for chart-based financial outlook) or phone/email ($295).
- **Webinars and Virtual Education**
- **Books and Annual Forecast publications**
- **Investment Retreats** -- E.g., the upcoming May 20-24, 2026 retreat at Lake Bled, Slovenia.

**Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA):** Founded 2013. A two-year training program consisting of 99 classes, competency tests, and seven major research projects. Graduates now serve as MMA analysts covering international markets, writing for the MMA Cycles Report and the MMTA International Cycles Report (ICR).

---

## 5. Track Record -- Notable Predictions

**Successes:**
- **2008 Financial Crisis:** As early as 1994, Merriman began warning of a major stock market decline and financial crisis in 2008, based primarily on the Saturn-Uranus 180-degree opposition forming at that time (a 45-year cycle). This prediction proved directionally correct.
- **2013 Market Timing Digest Award:** Won the Gold Star as "Best Market Timer of 2013" from Market Timing Digest (Amsterdam). He was the only contestant to correctly identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market.
- **2014 Market Timing Digest Award:** Won the Gold Star again, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.
- **Gold Trade Example:** Recommended going long gold at 1825 +/- 10 with a stop-loss below 1790. Gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week and rallied to 2152 within two months.
- A client testimonial claims 36 trades closed in one year with an 86% win rate using his methodology.

**Failures / Questionable Calls:**
- **2010 and 2014 Continued Bear Market:** After correctly calling 2008, Merriman expected further significant declines in 2010 and 2014 based on challenging Saturn-Uranus-Pluto aspects. These did not materialize, as unprecedented central bank intervention (QE) drove markets to record highs. He attributed this to policy intervention "nullifying" the astrological signals -- critics view this as post-hoc rationalization.

**Important Caveats:**
- The track record claims come primarily from Merriman's own website and marketing materials, including cherry-picked trade examples and client testimonials.
- No independent, third-party audits or systematic verifications of his overall prediction accuracy have been found in the public record.
- The Market Timing Digest awards, while external, are from a niche publication, not a mainstream financial authority.

---

## 6. Specific Techniques -- Planetary Cycles and Application

**Long-Term Planetary Cycles:**
- **Jupiter-Saturn Conjunction (~20-year cycle):** The "Great Mutation" cycle. The 2000 conjunction at 22 degrees Taurus (square Uranus in Aquarius) coincided with the dot-com crash. These conjunctions cycle through zodiac elements (fire, earth, air, water) over ~200-year periods.
- **Saturn-Uranus (~45-year cycle):** The opposition phase (2008-2010) correlated with the financial crisis. The waning sextile phase (April 2025-January 2026) is currently being studied.
- **Saturn-Neptune (~36-year cycle):** Particularly significant for grain markets.
- **Jupiter-Uranus, Saturn-Pluto, Neptune-Pluto, Uranus-Pluto:** All studied in Volume 2 for correlations to 50-week or greater market cycles going back to 1789.

**Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs):**
- Calculated as the midpoint between the first and last geocosmic signature in a "cluster" (where no more than 6 calendar days separate consecutive signatures).
- Rated 1-3 stars: 3-star dates have at least two "Level 1" signatures within 4 calendar days. A Level 1 signature has at least 66% historical correlation to a primary cycle reversal within 12 trading days.

**Solar/Lunar Methodology (Short-Term):**
- Every Sun-Moon sign combination (e.g., Sun in Aries, Moon in Scorpio) is scored by historical correlation to 4%+ price reversals in the DJIA, NASDAQ, and Nikkei over 60 years of daily data.
- Weighted Value (WV) scoring: WV of 138+ is "higher than norm," 160+ is "very high." Below 83 suggests low reversal probability. About 30 high-probability 1-2 day reversal windows are identified per year per index.
- Trading setup: On a high-WV solar/lunar day, look for the price to exceed the prior day's high or low, then confirm with an "isolated high" or "isolated low" the following day.

**Planetary Ingresses and Stations:**
- A planet changing signs (ingress) is considered nearly as significant as aspects.
- Retrograde/direct stations of planets are also mapped to market reversals.

**Current Focus (2025-2026):**
- Pluto in Aquarius (for ~20 years), Neptune entering Aries, Uranus entering Gemini (July 2025) -- all three outer planets changing signs within two years, something that hasn't happened in 300 years. Merriman calls this the "Aries Vortex" and the midpoint of the "New Aira" (2020-2032).

**Astrological:**

- Helped formulate ISAR's certification criteria in the mid-1990s, which became the international standard for astrological professionalism

## 8. Influence on the Field of Financial Astrology

Merriman is widely regarded as the most influential living figure in financial astrology:

- **Pioneered quantitative financial astrology:** His 1982 "Gold Book" was the first to apply systematic, quantitative correlation analysis between planetary cycles and financial market data, moving the field beyond anecdotal claims.
- **Created the largest body of research:** The five-volume "Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing" is the most comprehensive research effort ever conducted on geocosmic correlations to financial markets.
- **Institutional reach:** The MMA Cycles Report is used by banks and financial institutions worldwide, giving financial astrology a degree of credibility it had not previously had.
- **Built a training pipeline:** Through MMTA, he has trained over 100 analysts who now produce independent market analysis using his methodology, creating a second generation of practitioners.
- **Professional bridge-builder:** His CTA registration, Wall Street experience, and use of the neutral term "geocosmic" (rather than "astrology") helped make financial astrology accessible to traders who might otherwise dismiss it.
- **Community leadership:** Seven terms as ISAR president; Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession" (1995); Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award" (2012, only the fourth person to receive it).
- **Published in 10 languages**, with a global following across North America, Europe, and Asia.
- **Active community engagement:** Discussed on The Astrology Podcast, astrology forums, trading communities (Trade2Win), and presents at major conferences like UAC.
- **Media exposure:** Featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street.

---

## 9. Criticism and Controversies

**Scientific and Methodological Criticisms:**

1. **No plausible physical mechanism:** There is no known physical force by which planetary positions could influence stock prices, interest rates, or commodity prices. Proponents speak of "energies" or "vibrations" without measurable scientific definitions.

2. **Pseudoscience classification:** Financial astrology is classified as pseudoscience by the scientific community. Astrology has been rejected for having no explanatory power. Karl Popper cited astrology as his primary example of pseudoscience, and the most rigorous test (Shawn Carlson's double-blind study) found astrology performed no better than chance.

3. **Confirmation bias:** Critics argue that practitioners selectively highlight successful predictions while ignoring failures. Trading community discussions (e.g., Trade2Win forums) repeatedly raise the question: "How many reversals has he called that didn't work?"

4. **Post-hoc rationalization:** Merriman's explanation that central bank intervention "nullified" the astrological signals for 2010 and 2014 is seen as classic unfalsifiable reasoning -- if the prediction works, astrology is validated; if it fails, an external factor is blamed.

5. **Vague and unfalsifiable claims:** Forecasts often identify broad "time bands" rather than specific dates and directions, making rigorous backtesting difficult. The use of probabilities and ranges provides built-in protection against being definitively wrong.

6. **Cherry-picked evidence:** Track record claims come primarily from self-reported data, client testimonials, and selected trade examples. No independent audit of overall performance has been published.

7. **Survivorship and selection bias in research:** Studying 200+ years of planetary aspects against market data with many possible combinations creates a high risk of finding spurious correlations through data mining.

8. **Contradicts established financial theory:** The Efficient Market Hypothesis holds that all available information is already priced in. If planetary positions were genuinely predictive, the information would be arbitraged away.

9. **Rare events problem:** Some planetary configurations (e.g., specific outer planet conjunctions) occur only once in a lifetime, providing essentially no statistical sample from which to draw reliable conclusions.

**Merriman's Responses to Critics:**
- He argues that financial astrology is inherently falsifiable (unlike natal astrology), because specific market predictions can be checked against actual outcomes.
- He dismisses critics who cite the precession of equinoxes as showing "the critic's ignorance of the mechanics used in astrology."
- He points to his Market Timing Digest awards as objective validation.
- He acknowledges that geocosmics alone cannot forecast direction -- they only identify timing windows. This built-in limitation makes the system harder to definitively falsify.

---

## 10. Current Activities and Relevance (2025-2026)

Merriman remains highly active at age 79:

- **Forecast 2026** -- Published his 50th Annual Forecast Book, centered on the "Aries Vortex" (2025-2027) and midpoint of the "New Aira" (2020-2032).
- **Free Weekly Column** -- Continues publishing weekly at mmacycles.com. Recent columns (May 2026) discuss geopolitical events (Iran/Hormuz blockade) and market cycle analysis.
- **Investment Retreats** -- Hosting the May 20-24, 2026 retreat at Lake Bled, Slovenia (sold out, 45 rooms).
- **UAC 2026 Conference** -- Presenting a Pre-Conference Workshop on Financial Astrology (September 3, 2026) and a lecture on mundane astrology (September 5, 2026) at the United Astrology Congress in Chicago.
- **Current Market Analysis** -- Noting that a 50-week cycle may have bottomed but several longer cycles are expected to trough between now and mid-2028, positioning this as a potential long-term buying opportunity.
- **Key Astrological Themes He's Tracking:** Pluto in Aquarius (technology/AI disruption), Neptune entering Aries, Uranus entering Gemini (July 2025) -- a rare concentration of outer planet sign changes not seen in 300 years.
- **MMA Team Expansion** -- MMTA graduates continue to produce analysis for international markets.
- **Podcast** -- MMA Merriman Market Analysis Podcast active on Spotify.
- **YouTube Channel** -- Active with regular video content.

---

## Summary Assessment

Raymond Merriman occupies a unique niche: he is arguably the only person who has held both legitimate Wall Street credentials (CTA, Series 3/7, positions at Prudential, E.F. Hutton, Paine Webber) and the highest leadership positions in the astrological community (ISAR president, Regulus Lifetime Achievement). His five-volume research series on geocosmic correlations to market cycles is unmatched in scope within financial astrology. He runs a durable business (MMA, founded 1983) that has operated continuously for over 40 years.

His most impressive verifiable claims are the 2013 and 2014 Market Timing Digest Gold Star awards and the directionally correct 2008 crisis forecast made 14 years in advance. However, the broader field of financial astrology remains classified as pseudoscience by the scientific community, with no plausible mechanism, no independent audits of overall track records, and significant risks of confirmation bias and data mining in the underlying research methodology.

# Raymond A. Merriman 深度调研报告

## 基本信息

- **现居**：美国亚利桑那州 Cave Creek

---

## 职业生涯

| 1980 | 师从传奇商品期货周期分析师 Walter Bressert |
| 1981 | 创立 Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) |
| 1982 | 出版《The Gold Book》，注册为 CTA（受 NFA/CFTC 监管） |

**关键点**：他是极少数同时持有华尔街正式资质（Series 3/Series 7、CTA注册）和占星界最高领导职务（ISAR主席共七届、任期最长）的人。

---

## 核心方法论：三层融合体系

Merriman 的方法不是纯占星，而是将三个学科融合：

### 1. 市场周期分析（非占星）
继承自导师 Walter Bressert 的经典周期理论——识别价格数据中的重复周期，每个大周期包含更小的子周期。这部分完全是技术分析范畴。

### 2. 宇宙地理学 (Geocosmics)（占星相位与市场的相关性）
核心原则：**行星周期越长，对应的市场趋势周期也越长**。研究外行星（木星、土星、天王星、海王星、冥王星）之间的相位（合相、对冲、三分相等），映射到中长期市场周期。

### 3. 技术分析
常规图表形态、均线、技术指标作为入场/出场的价格确认。

**三者如何协同**：
- Geocosmics 告诉你 **"何时"** 可能反转
- 周期相位分析告诉你 **"向哪个方向"** 反转（顶部还是底部）
- 技术分析告诉你 **"在哪个价位"** 操作

他刻意使用 "geocosmic" 而非 "astrology" 一词，因为"在金融市场领域，用'占星'这个词很难获得关注"。

---

## 关键行星周期与市场对应

| 行星周期 | 周期长度 | 市场对应 |
|---------|---------|---------|
| 木星-土星合相 | ~20年 | "大变异"周期，2000年合相对应互联网泡沫 |
| 土星-天王星 | ~45年 | 2008-2010对冲相位对应金融危机 |
| 土星-海王星 | ~36年 | 粮食/农产品市场 |
| 天王星-冥王星 | 超长周期 | 系统性变革时期 |

### 关键反转日 (Critical Reversal Dates, CRDs)
- 取一组行星相位"集群"的中点日期
- 按1-3星评级（3星 = 4天内至少两个"一级相位"，一级相位 = 历史上66%以上概率对应主周期反转）
- 每年约产生30个高概率反转窗口

### 日月短线交易系统
- 研究了60年 DJIA/NASDAQ/日经 日线数据
- 对每种太阳-月亮星座组合计算加权值 (Weighted Value)
- WV ≥ 138 为"高于正常"，≥ 160 为"非常高"
- 具体交易设置：高WV日看价格是否突破前日高/低点，次日确认

著作已翻译成德、意、荷、法、俄、塞、捷、越、日等10种语言。

## 战绩：成功与失败

### 成功案例
- **2008金融危机**：早在1994年就基于土星-天王星对冲（45年周期）预警2008年将有重大股市下跌和金融危机。提前14年，方向正确。
- **2013年**：获 Market Timing Digest 金星奖"年度最佳择时师"——唯一正确识别出美股全部15个主要转折点的参赛者。
- **2014年**：再次获金星奖，提前识别出21个反转日中的20个。
- **黄金交易**：推荐在1825±10做多黄金，止损1790以下。金价当周触底1823.50，两个月内涨至2152。

### 失败案例
- **2010/2014持续看空**：2008正确后，基于土星-天王星-冥王星相位继续预期大幅下跌。但央行QE推动市场创新高。他将此归因于政策干预"抵消"了占星信号——**批评者认为这是事后合理化**。

### 重要警示
- 战绩数据主要来自 MMA 自己的网站和营销材料
- **没有独立第三方审计**或系统性验证
- Market Timing Digest 奖项来自小众出版物，非主流金融权威

---

- **每周免费专栏**：mmacycles.com 公开发布

- **投资研修班**：如2026年5月斯洛文尼亚 Lake Bled（已售罄）
- **个人咨询**：Zoom $50/月，电话/邮件 $295

---

## 批评与争议

| 批评 | 详情 |
|------|------|
| **无物理机制** | 没有已知物理力可以让行星位置影响股价 |
| **伪科学分类** | 科学界将金融占星归类为伪科学 |
| **确认偏差** | 选择性展示成功预测，忽略失败 |
| **不可证伪** | 预测成功→占星验证；预测失败→外部因素干扰 |
| **模糊预测** | 给出宽泛"时间窗口"而非精确日期和方向 |
| **数据挖掘风险** | 200年数据 × 大量行星组合 → 高概率发现虚假相关性 |
| **与有效市场假说矛盾** | 如果真能预测，信息会被套利消除 |
| **小样本问题** | 某些外行星相位一生只出现一次，无统计意义 |

---

## 当前动态 (2025-2026)

79岁的 Merriman 仍非常活跃：
- 出版第50版年度预测书《Forecast 2026》
- 持续发布每周免费专栏
- 关注"白羊旋涡" (Aries Vortex, 2025-2027)——冥王星入水瓶、海王星入白羊、天王星入双子，三颗外行星在两年内换座，300年未见
- 2026年9月将在芝加哥 UAC 大会做金融占星工作坊
- MMA 播客和 YouTube 频道活跃中

---

## 总结评价

Merriman 在金融占星领域的地位类似于该领域的"教父"——他是唯一一个同时拥有华尔街正规资质和占星界最高荣誉的人。他的五卷本研究是该领域最系统的量化研究尝试。MMA 持续运营超过40年，说明其商业模式是可持续的。

**但从量化投资的角度看**：他的方法论核心——行星相位与市场周期的相关性——缺乏物理机制支撑，存在严重的数据挖掘和确认偏差风险，且没有独立第三方对整体预测准确率的审计验证。他最有价值的部分可能是**纯周期分析**（非占星部分），这与你现有的技术指标体系可以互补参考。

## Overview

**Raymond A. Merriman** is the author of *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, a five-volume series published between 1997 and 2012. He authored several books on Financial Market Timing, including the five-part series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* (1997-2012). From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

---

## The Five Volumes

1. **Volume 1: Cycles and Patterns in the Indexes** – This is a book about probabilities in the stock market. It covers the entire history of the New York Stock Exchange (1789–1997) as well as the Japanese Nikkei Stock Index (1949–1997). It identifies 15 long- and short-term recurrent cycles and the types of patterns which unfold in each, explaining not only WHEN a market is likely to form an important crest or trough, but also HOW that cycle will unfold.

2. **Volume 2: Geocosmic Correlations to Investment Cycles** – Focuses on the relationship between geocosmic (astrological/planetary) signatures and longer-term investment cycles.

3. **Volume 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles** – This is the most comprehensive reference book to date on the relationship of geocosmic signatures to reversals in the U.S. stock indices. It is written specifically for traders or analysts of U.S. stocks and stock indices.

4. **Volume 4: Solar/Lunar Correlations to Short-Term Trading Cycles** – Volume 4 is the most comprehensive analysis yet of all the Sun-Moon combinations and their correspondence to price movements in stock indices. It examines 60 years of daily data on the DJIA, and the past 16–18 years of daily data on the NASDAQ Composite and Japanese Nikkei. In all, there are approximately 30 of these 1–2 day periods that stand out as high-probability trade dates each year, in each index.

5. **Volume 5: Technical Analysis and Price Objectives** – This is the long-awaited last volume of the five-volume series. The first volume was released in 1997, and all four prior volumes focused on market timing: WHEN to buy or sell. This book now provides the final part, the missing link: WHERE — at what price — to buy or sell. Volume 5 is in paperback format, 300 pages, printed in October 2012.

---

## About the Author

Raymond A. Merriman is a market analyst and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory market letter issued 12 times per year and used by financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981. He also issues a weekly and daily market report with recommendations on various markets.

Between 1982–1986, Raymond Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects. These courses are now available to new students for online learning.

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." In 2014, he received the Gold Star award again, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

---

The complete set of all five volumes is available through Merriman's official website at [mmacycles.com](https://www.mmacycles.com) and through Amazon.
