## About the Author

Raymond Merriman is the President of Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University.

Raymond Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

## Notable Books

His key published works include:

- **The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles (1982)** – This was his first publication, and it was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos (now out of print).

- **The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing (5 volumes, 1997–2012)** – This five-volume series became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

- **Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics** – First published in 1994.

- **The New Solar Return Book of Prediction (revised edition)** – also available on Amazon.

## Translations & Reach

His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.

## Awards & Recognition

- In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013."
- In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest.
- In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

## Raymond Merriman – Financial Astrology & Market Timing

Raymond Merriman is the President of Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a financial market analyst.

### Background & Education
Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology from Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969–1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst. Under Bressert's tutelage, Merriman began his research in the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, which resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles."

### Professional Career
Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972.

### Methodology
His approach focuses on when geocosmic patterns unfold when a market cycle is also due. For instance, most markets have an 18-week primary cycle, within an orb of three weeks. His studies show that this time band can be narrowed down to three trading days or less if a strong geocosmic signature is in effect. Some geocosmic factors are labeled Levels 1, 2, or 3, depending on their historical correlation to reversals. He prefers the word "forecast" to "prediction," because the word forecast refers to probabilities—identifying time bands with the highest probability for the completion of a market cycle.

His work is described as an introduction to the art of market timing, combining the study of market cycles with planetary cycles to accurately identify turning points in financial markets. He argues that financial markets are not "random" as many people think.

### Books & Publications
Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Volumes 1–5 (1997–2012); *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982); *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006); *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015); and the annual Forecast Book (since 1976), which outlines his projections a year ahead of time for financial markets, the world economy, and political trends.

In 2013, he created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology.

### Awards & Recognition
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant (of twelve who were followed) to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. By contrast, the second-place finisher successfully identified 12. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest.

At UAC (United Astrology Congress) 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award."

### Current Activity
Merriman continues to present his work, arguing that financial markets move in patterns of rhythmic cycles, and when time bands for cycle highs or lows are due, they often overlap with certain planetary aspects or stations. Using actual research studies, his workshops demonstrate how certain astrological factors have correlated with important trend reversals in financial markets.

His website and weekly forecasts are available at [mmacycles.com](https://www.mmacycles.com/).

## Raymond (Ray) Merriman on The Astrology Podcast

Ray Merriman has appeared on at least **two episodes** of The Astrology Podcast, hosted by Chris Brennan:

### 1. Episode 76 – *Financial Astrology with Ray Merriman* (May 2016)
This episode is an interview with astrologer Ray Merriman on financial astrology, and the use of astrology to time changes in different financial markets. Ray is the President of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR), and he is one of the most well-known financial astrologers in the astrological community.

Topics covered in this episode include:
- Ray's background and early history with astrology, studying astrology since the 1960s.
- Incorporation charts for companies, studying financial markets with astrology, and the necessity of being an expert both in astrology and in trading.
- Prediction versus forecasting, and financial astrology as a falsifiable application of astrology.
- His book *Solar-Lunar Keys to Gold Prices: Secrets of a Gold Trader*, and identifying highs and lows in the gold market prices.

This episode was recorded on Monday, May 9, 2016, starting just after 12:00 PM, in Denver, Colorado.

### 2. Episode 217 – *Organizing Astrology Conferences, with Ray Merriman* (August 2019)
Episode 217 features an interview with astrologer Ray Merriman about what is involved in organizing a major astrology conference. He has organized more than 20 astrology conferences over the course of his career, and was in the process of helping to organize his final conference — the ISAR astrology conference held in Denver in September of 2020.

They ended up talking about a range of topics, including speaker selection, how to apply to speak at a conference, and how astrology conferences have changed over the past few decades.

### About The Astrology Podcast
It is a weekly podcast on the history, philosophy, and techniques of astrology, hosted by professional astrologer Chris Brennan.

You can find more about Ray Merriman's work at **mmacycles.com**, and the episodes are available on the podcast's website at [theastrologypodcast.com](https://theastrologypodcast.com), as well as on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

## Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

### Background & Education

Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst.

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972.

### Career Highlights

Between 1982-1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### Books & Publications

Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Volumes 1–5 (1997-2012); *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982); *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006); *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015); and the annual *Forecast Book* (since 1976).

His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.

### Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) — Reviews & Methodology

As featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street, Merriman Market Analyst is the leader in market timing products and services.

Their tools integrate a combination of Cycles, Geocosmic Signatures, and Trend Analysis patterns that assist the serious investor in interpreting the markets.

#### Client Testimonials

- "The Daily Report is the best investment ever made, it simply confirms some of my own calculations, but most important it is a real confidence booster. It really clears up the short term to survive the long term. Absolutely priceless."

- One subscriber noted that MMA's services helped them uncover a passionate interest in financial market timing and astrology, turning their investing journey "from one of stress and frustration to one of excitement and enjoyment."

### Goodreads Ratings

On Goodreads, Raymond Merriman has an average rating of 4.19 across 26 ratings and 2 reviews, with 314 shelved works.

His work has received positive reviews from clients and subscribers, and he has been recognized with market timing awards. His books and advisory services are used internationally by traders and financial institutions.

## Raymond Merriman – Author Overview

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

## Key Books

### *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* (5-Volume Series)
From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

A notable review of Volume 5 by Duke O'Neil (President, Capstone Capital Wealth Management) praised the series highly: "I have been following Ray Merriman's forecasts and method of market analysis for over a dozen years and what he has accomplished in the field is no small task. The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing series is truly a life's work of grand proportion. I have stated before that Ray Merriman has built the foundation upon which Financial Astrology can securely rest." Volumes 1–4 were described as "more than a foundation, they were an edifice," and Volume 5 was called "the pinnacle." Coupled with the timing strategies of the first four volumes, these volumes were said to provide a complete trading methodology, brilliantly and logically presented.

### *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics*
*Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics* was first published in 1994. It serves as a primer on financial market cycle analysis.

### *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing*
This is a basic textbook on the relationship of geocosmic correlations to financial markets.

### *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles*
Under Walter Bressert's tutelage, Merriman published *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* in 1982 (now out of print). This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

### *The New Solar Return Book of Prediction*
This is another well-known title, focusing on astrological prediction methods. It is listed on Amazon and Goodreads among Merriman's bibliography.

## Goodreads Ratings
On Goodreads, Raymond Merriman has an average rating of 4.19 across 26 ratings and 2 reviews, with his books shelved 314 times.

## Awards & Recognition
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands, as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014, he received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year," this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

## Availability
His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English. Many of his books can be found on Amazon and ThriftBooks, though several titles are currently out of stock or out of print.

---

Overall, Raymond Merriman's books are well-regarded within the niche of financial astrology and market cycle analysis, with his five-volume *Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* series being considered his magnum opus. If you'd like more detailed reviews on a specific title, feel free to ask!

## Raymond Merriman: Overview and Analysis

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

### Background and Education

Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969–1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst.

### Career in Finance

Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

### Methodology

Merriman Market Analyst combines decades of expertise with innovative tools to give investors a unique edge in navigating financial markets. Through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, they provide resources and education to help traders make informed decisions.

His methodology is distinctive — and controversial — in that it blends traditional financial analysis with astrological ("geocosmic") principles. Markets have rhythmic cycles with patterns. For example, an 18-week cycle has sub-cycles of two 9-week intervals, and/or three sub-cycles of 6-week intervals. The analysis starts with knowing the market's rhythmic cycle – when each cycle or sub-cycle is due – and then looks for the geocosmic signature that is unfolding.

### Astrology Connection

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972. He is the author of *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope* (1977) and *The Solar Return Book of Prediction* (1977).

He is a Professional (Certified) Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers, as well as through ISAR, the International Society of Astrological Research (2000). In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image As a Profession," and in 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award."

### Published Works

His five-volume series, *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, was first released in 1997, with the prior four volumes focused on market timing (WHEN to buy or sell) and the final volume providing the missing link: WHERE — at what price — to buy or sell. The five-volume set covers geocosmic, cycles, pattern recognition, trend analysis, and technical analysis studies. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

### Awards and Recognition

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year," this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### Critical Perspective

The search results did not surface independent, skeptical third-party critiques or peer-reviewed analyses of Merriman's methodology. The available results are largely from his own website (mmacycles.com), Amazon book listings, and affiliated sites. His approach — combining traditional cycle analysis with financial astrology — is inherently controversial within mainstream finance, as there is no broadly accepted scientific basis for correlating planetary positions with market movements. While he has received recognition within the astrology and market-timing communities, mainstream financial academia and the broader investment community generally view astrological market forecasting with significant skepticism.

If you're looking for more specific critical reviews or academic critiques, I can refine the search further.

## Raymond Merriman – Prediction & Forecasting Accuracy

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972.

### Market Timing Awards & Accuracy Claims

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria.

In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### Forecasting Methodology

Merriman's firm prefers the word "forecast" to "prediction," because the word forecast refers to probabilities. They identify those time bands that have the highest probability to the completion of a market cycle that is due at that time. This is the basis for their "higher-than-average accuracy" in forecasting market turns.

Markets also have rhythmic cycles that have patterns. For example, an 18-week cycle has sub-cycles of two 9-week intervals, and/or three sub-cycles of 6-week intervals, each with a narrow time band known as an orb of allowance. The analysis starts with knowing the market's rhythmic cycle – when each cycle or its sub-cycle is due.

### Client Testimonials

One client testimonial on the MMA website states: "Thanks to Raymond Merriman, I have closed 36 trades this year with a win rate of 86%. Ray's predictive ability is remarkable. No one predicts more accurately."

### Books & Publications

Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* (Volumes 1–5, 1997–2012), *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982), *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006), *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015), and the annual *Forecast Book* (since 1976), which outlines his projections a year ahead of time for financial markets, the world economy, and political trends.

The 2025 edition marks MMA's 49th Annual Forecast Book.

### Trade Examples

In one highlighted example, Merriman recommended going long on gold at 1825 ± 10 with a stop-loss on a close below 1790. Gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week. By December 4, less than two months later, it traded as high as 2152.

### Important Context

It's worth noting that much of the information about Merriman's prediction accuracy comes from his own website and marketing materials. Merriman's methodology combines geocosmic signatures with market cycle analysis — geocosmic signatures are not considered sole predictors of market trends; markets also have rhythmic cycles that have patterns. His approach blends financial astrology with technical analysis, which is a non-mainstream methodology. Independent, peer-reviewed verification of his long-term track record is not readily available from these search results.

## **The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles**
**By Raymond A. Merriman**

### Key Details:
- The book was authored by Raymond Allen Merriman, published as a print book in English in 1982. The ISBN is **9780930706135** (ISBN-10: **0930706137**).
- It was published by Seek It Pubns, out of West Bloomfield, Michigan, in 1982.
- The book is xiv, 324 pages.

### About the Book:
- Under Walter Bressert's tutelage, Merriman began his research on the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, which resulted in the publication of *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* in 1982 (now out-of-print).
- This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.
- Raymond A. Merriman, publisher of the M.M.A. Market Newsletter, reveals the results of years of intensive research which has yielded 147 correlations with reliability factors exceeding 70%.
- The book is packed with information on how to spot long and short-term cycles in the gold market, covering everything from price objectives to very sophisticated time objectives, from beginning technical analysis to refined tools in cycles' analysis.
- The original and unique methods of timing crests and troughs of the gold market with such acute accuracy, as presented in this work, are described as exciting for both students and experts alike.

### About the Author:
- Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report since 1982.
- His introduction to financial markets began in 1978, and two years later he became a student of Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst in commodities.
- From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which took 15 years to complete and comprises over 1,600 pages.

### Availability:
- The hardcover edition is exceptionally scarce. Copies are available through used book dealers on AbeBooks, Biblio, and other platforms.

## Overview of the MMTA Program

The Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA) is a comprehensive educational program designed for aspiring financial analysts, market timing specialists, investors, and traders. The MMTA program is a two-year course. The purpose is to teach one the methodology of analyzing financial markets, and to train students in market timing skills, according to the studies developed by Raymond Merriman since 1980.

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years.

---

## Curriculum & Course Structure

### MMTA4 (Latest Version)

The entire MMTA4 program is two years long and will cover eight courses. Each course is approximately 6-8 weeks long, with a break in between each course, and a 3-month break between years one and two. In each class session, they cover 1-4 lessons. The classes are offered live online via Zoom and each class is recorded and made available to access through the website portal. Each course is finished with an exam and research assignment for students who wish to graduate and receive a certification.

Over eight structured courses, students explore leading indicators such as financial market cycles, geocosmic correlations to long-, intermediate- and short-term market cycles, as well as advanced technical analysis methods, including price objectives calculations, chart patterns, and support and resistance calculations. The program equips students with the skills to accurately forecast market reversals, write market reports for different time frames, as well as derive and execute investment and trading strategies. Extensive practical exercises and real-world applications ensure students gain hands-on experience.

**Key topics covered include** (as described on the curriculum page):
Cycles, chart patterns, geocosmic correlations, and trading strategies; the curriculum teaches how to create effective trading plans, calculate price objectives, and execute short-term trades with confidence.

### Course Example (from the first MMTA in 2013):
Course dates for MMTA4 include sessions in September–November 2025, with Course Two covering "Geocosmic Correlations to Long-Term Cycles in Financial Markets."

### Faculty
The program is led by both Raymond Merriman, president of MMA, and Wiebke Held, MMTA Program Director. Additional MMA faculty joining MMTA4 include: Gianni Di Poce, Wyatt Fellows, Pouyan Zolfagharnia, Derek Panaia, Rita Perea, and Kat Powell.

---

## Certification

A certificate of completion will be granted to all those who wish to be recognized as MMTA graduates. Taking exams at the end of each course, plus a final exam at the completion of all courses, is required. Also required are research studies conducted and presented. However, one may take the program for their own benefit if one does not wish a certificate of completion.

Graduates receive certificates of completion, recognized by others in the field as a solid grounding as a market analyst specializing in market timing. Several graduates of the first MMTA program are now paid analysts for various MMA and ICR reports. Others have gone on to start their own market letters or work as analysts for other financial firms. Several have simply used the learning to manage their own trading and investment accounts.

---

## Cost / Pricing

Here is the pricing information found across different iterations of the MMTA:

- **Original MMTA (2013–2014, in-person):** The cost of the entire two-year program was $20,000/person. The courses took place on-site and in person at the Michigan State University Management Education Center in Troy, Michigan.

- **MMTA2/MMTA3 (online recordings, course-by-course):** The cost for each course is $1,800 (7 classes in each course, approximately 15 hours of recordings per course). Or the entire 4-course recordings are available for a discounted price of $6,600 (save $600 by ordering the full set of four courses).

- **Standalone Market Timing Courses:** The cost for each course is $995 (a savings of over $1,000 from the cost of Courses 1 and 2 in MMTA). The cost includes the text of each class, the webinar recordings (in English and Chinese), as well as the power point slides.

For the latest MMTA4 pricing, students are directed to email mmta@mmacycles.com for additional information.

---

## About Raymond Merriman

He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982. From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA.

## MMA Solar Lunar Forecasting App by Raymond Merriman

The MMA Solar Lunar Forecasting App is the newest and ultimate market timing tool for active traders. It is based on the most rigorous research performed on the historical correlation of solar/lunar combinations to short-term trading reversals.

### What It Does

The MMA App is a market timing tool that provides weighted value (WV) scores based on Sun/Moon historical studies of reversals of at least 3%. The higher the WV, the greater the frequency that a reversal of at least 3% has occurred previously.

With the new MMA Solar Lunar Forecasting App, traders will receive real-time alerts on high probability dates for short-term market reversals.

### Markets Covered

The MMA Solar-Lunar App offers reversal signals for the DJIA, NASDAQ, Gold, and Silver. It is an ideal tool to have in your back pocket if you are a short-term swing trader looking for high-probability dates that identify isolated lows and highs in these markets.

### How It Works

Users stay ahead of the trend with notifications when WV scores exceed 138, signaling the highest likelihood of a 3% market move.

The trades highlighted by the MMA Solar/Lunar App work best for short-term trading, usually for 1-4 day trades, sometimes lasting a week, and in less frequent cases, even more.

### Intellectual Property & Development

The concept of Solar/Lunar correlations to financial markets is the intellectual property and creation of Raymond Merriman. The studies are conducted by MMTA graduate Yating Hu, who graduated from MMTA in 2022, and focused on the correlation of solar/lunar values to reversals in several financial markets including DJIA, Gold, Silver, Shanghai Composite, and the Euro currency. The programming of these values into the MMA Solar/Lunar App was conducted by MMTA3 student Jonathan Beuhler, an accomplished programmer.

### Availability & Pricing

The app is currently available only on Apple devices (iPhone and iPad). It requires iOS 17.0 or later, or macOS 14.0 or later with an Apple M1 chip or later.

Using an Apple device, users can sign up at the rate of $39.99/month. A yearly rate of $299.00 is also available.

Plans were in progress to create an Android version of the app, as well as a crypto app.

### Best Practices

This should not be used as a standalone system. It works best as an adjunct tool when cycle lows or highs are due, when a market is in a technically overbought or oversold condition, or when it is exhibiting intermarket bullish or bearish divergence relative to a related market.

### Additional Software Tools

MMA also offers other software tools, including:

- **Solar Fire Astrology Software**, whose capabilities include natal, progression, directed, any planet or asteroid return, pre-natal, rising/setting, lunar phase, locality, heliocentric, composite, harmonic and harmonic arc transform charts and more.
- **FAR for Galactic Trader Software**, which has recently been upgraded to conduct solar/lunar weighted value studies for any market by isolating or omitting any planet that is retrograde — for instance, comparing solar/lunar values when Mercury (or Venus, Mars, or any planet) is retrograde or direct, or both.

---

You can find the app on the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/merriman-market-analyst/id6476158887) or learn more on the [MMA Cycles website](https://www.mmacycles.com).

## Overview of the MMA Cycles Report

Raymond Merriman is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

The MMA Cycles Report is a monthly newsletter, with occasional special updates, written by Raymond Merriman and used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981.

### What the Report Covers

The monthly MMA Cycles Report is one of the most insightful, reliable, and usable market letters in existence today – and it has been for over 35 years! Used by both small and large traders, individual investors, and financial institutions throughout the world since 1982, it has developed a solid global following for its concrete and timely analysis of the economy, interest rates, stock, precious metals, currencies, and grain markets.

Each issue contains MMA's proprietary CRDs (Critical Reversal Dates) that are in effect for the next month (usually 1–3 dates).

### Analysts

Analysts include Ray Merriman (Review and Preview, Key Points), Gianni Di Poce (DJIA, S&P, T-Notes, SMI), Wyatt Fellows (Soybeans, Gold), Pouyan Zolfagharnia (Copper, Crude Oil, Silver), and Ulric Aspegren (Euro).

## Raymond Merriman & Financial Astrology: Overview

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

Raymond Merriman has served the astrological community for over 50 years. He passed the AFA Professional Astrological exam in 1972, at the time (and maybe still), the youngest person ever to do so.

### His Methodology

Merriman Market Analyst offers "innovative market timing solutions, leveraging a combination of advanced analytical methodologies." It combines decades of expertise with innovative tools, using market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis to provide resources and education to help traders make informed decisions.

Merriman prefers the word "forecast" to "prediction," because the word forecast refers to probabilities. The methodology identifies time bands that have the highest probability for the completion of a market cycle that is due at that time, which is the basis for higher-than-average accuracy in forecasting market turns.

### Beginner / Introductory Resources

## Raymond Merriman & Geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs)

**Raymond A. Merriman** is a market analyst, author, and the founder of **Merriman Market Analyst (MMA)**, a leader in geocosmic market timing. He is the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory market letter used by financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981.

### What Are Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs)?

CRDs are specific dates identified by Merriman's methodology where financial markets are likely to experience trend reversals. The system states, "Look for cycle turns in many markets within three trading days of the forthcoming critical reversal dates," and then lists various dates with one, two, or three stars following each date.

- The number of stars refers to the date's historical consistency with primary cycles. The dates themselves are midpoints in time between the first and last signature of a "cluster" of signatures, where no more than 6 calendar days separate any two consecutive signatures.

### Star Rating System

- **Three Stars (★★★):** These periods have the highest probability of correlating to primary cycles in various financial markets, according to historical studies involving geocosmic signatures as reported in *The Gold Book* and *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing Volume 3*.
- **Two or Three Stars:** These mean there is at least one geocosmic signature nearby that is a "Level One" type, which has the highest correlation to a primary cycle within up to 12 trading days, with the correlation to primary cycles being at least 66%.
- In order for a critical reversal date to merit three stars, there are usually at least two Level 1 type signatures within 4 calendar days.

### Level 1, 2, and 3 Signatures

The methodology focuses on the primary cycle and its phases — the half-primary, major, and trading cycles — and then identifies geocosmic signatures at Levels 1, 2, and 3 as the basis for calculating CRDs, to narrow the time band for an important cycle reversal.

### Important Caveats

Merriman emphasizes that CRDs are probability-based, not predictive in a fortune-telling sense:

- Geocosmics alone cannot tell you what the trend is, and when a critical reversal hits, you never know whether the reversal will be a correction to the longer-term trend or the start of an entirely new underlying trend (a "primary thrust" in a new direction).
- The work is a work in probabilities, not inevitabilities.

### Recent CRD Examples

- Japan's Nikkei hit a new all-time high of 60,903 right on MMA's April 27th three-star geocosmic critical reversal date (CRD).
- Both Gold and Silver declined to possible major cycle lows on April 29, well within the orb of the 3-star geocosmic critical reversal period of April 24–27.
- A post-election rally in U.S. stocks posted a steep trading cycle low on November 19, 2024, well within orb of the November 15–18 two-star CRD.

### Annual Forecast Book & CRD Calendar

Merriman publishes an annual **Forecast Book** that includes CRDs for the year ahead. The *Forecast 2026* book includes Critical Reversal Dates in each market for 2026, favorable and challenging times, and represents MMA's 50th Annual Forecast Book. The *Forecast 2025* similarly covered the outlook for financial and commodity markets, including the all-important three-star geocosmic Critical Reversal Dates for 2025.

### Key Publications

Merriman has authored several books on financial market timing, including the five-part series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* (1997–2012), *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006), and *Solar/Lunar Keys to Gold Price Reversals* (2015).

For more information, you can visit his official website at **[mmacycles.com](https://www.mmacycles.com)**.

## Raymond Merriman – Research on Cycles and Correlations

**Raymond A. Merriman** is a prominent figure in the field of financial market timing, known for his extensive research on the correlation between planetary (geocosmic) cycles and financial market cycles.

### Background & Education
Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982. Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969, and he did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971.

### Key Research on Cycles Correlation
His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles' analyst. Under Walter's tutelage, Merriman began his research on the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, based on Walter's methodology of cycles analysis, which resulted in the publication of *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* in 1982. This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

### Major Research Publications
This was the first intensive study on the correlation of gold price cycles to geocosmic cycles to appear in published form, revealing the results of years of intensive research which yielded 147 correlations with reliability factors exceeding 70%.

He wanted to research and find all the cycles related to the stock market, which began a 16-year project that resulted in "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing," five volumes totaling over 1600 pages of research studies and strategies related to market cycles and their correlation to planetary cycles, as well as to chart patterns and specific technical momentum indicators. This was finally completed in 2012.

The idea is supported by quantitative research studies published in the 5-volume series of books titled *The Ultimate Books on Stock Market Timing*, which shows this correlation data of markets going back to the 17th century.

His other notable works include:
- *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006) and *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015).
- *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing*, a basic textbook on the relationship of geocosmic correlations to financial markets.

### The Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)
In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects identifying historical correlations between the analysis methods and historical performance.

### Recognition
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

It's worth noting that Merriman's work is rooted in "geocosmic" analysis—correlating planetary/astronomical cycles with financial market behavior—a field that is not recognized within mainstream academic finance or peer-reviewed scientific literature. His research is primarily published through his own company (MMA) and books rather than through traditional academic research journals.

## Raymond Merriman – Conference Presentations & Videos (UAC, ISAR, NCGR)

### About Raymond Merriman
Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report. At UAC (United Astrology Congress) 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award." He also served as president of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR) in 1994–2000, 2002–2008, and 2015–2017.

### UAC Conference History & Involvement
Episode 421 of The Astrology Podcast is a documentary about the 1986 United Astrology Conference, which was the first time that UAC was hosted by AFAN, ISAR, and the NCGR. Some of the astrologers featured in the documentary include Rob Hand, Joan McEvers, Marion March, Jim Lewis, Michel Gauquelin, and Ray Merriman, among many others.

- **UAC 2008**: Madalyn Hillis-Dineen, Ray Merriman, and Donna Van Toen were the conference coordinators.
- **UAC 2012**: Rob Hand, Donna Van Toen, Madalyn Hillis-Dineen, and Ray Merriman coordinated the conference, and more than 1,200 astrologers came from more than 40 countries.
- **UAC 2018**: Merriman participated in a panel titled "Central Banks and the Future of the Dollar and Euro" alongside Karen Hamaker-Zondag and Georgia Stathis.

### Videos
1. **YouTube – United Astrology Conference 1986 Documentary**: A documentary about the 1986 United Astrology Conference, which was the first time UAC was hosted by AFAN, ISAR, and the NCGR. Available at: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lm4SzYQxzOQ

2. **YouTube – Preview ISAR 2016 Ray Merriman**: A preview video for Merriman's presentation at the ISAR 2016 conference is available at: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DKVyTjc4B4k

### Podcast / Transcript
Merriman discussed how the last UAC involved five organizations — ISAR, NCGR, AFAN, AFA, and ACVA — all marketing UAC to their members or alumni, making the conference very large. This was covered in a transcript on The Astrology Podcast (Episode 217: "Organizing Astrology Conferences, with Ray Merriman").

### Role in Creating UAC
The coalition of AFAN, ISAR, and NCGR led to the first UAC in 1986 in San Diego. It was an astounding success, attended by over 800 people from all over the world.

## Raymond Merriman's FNN / Financial News Network Television Appearances

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

### FNN Television Appearances (1982–1986)

Between 1982-1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN).

According to Merriman's own account of how this came about, he started "The Merriman Market Analyst," Inc. with a market advisory report called "The MMA Cycles Report," specializing in the timing of cycle highs and lows in Gold prices. It started slowly with maybe 35 subscribers. But then FNN (Financial News Network) got a hold of the book he had written and flew him into Los Angeles for an interview.

In another interview, Merriman described this more specifically: he "got a call to appear on 'Money Talk' with the Financial News Network (FNN, before it became CNBC)."

### Background: The FNN-to-CNBC Transition

The Financial News Network (FNN) was an American financial and business news television network launched on November 30, 1981. After an accounting scandal, FNN filed for bankruptcy protection on March 2, 1991, and put itself up for sale. After a bidding war with a Dow Jones & Company–Westinghouse Broadcasting consortium, CNBC was awarded FNN by a bankruptcy judge for $154.3 million on May 21, 1991, and merged the two operations. CNBC adopted many elements of FNN's on-air presentation, branding its daytime programming as "CNBC/FNN Daytime" until 1992.

### Merriman's Career After FNN

Following his FNN appearances, he served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the Best Market Timer of 2013. He was the only contestant (of twelve who were followed) to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year," this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S stock market well ahead of time.

Raymond Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

## **Solar-Lunar Keys to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader**

**Author:** Raymond Merriman

**ISBN Details:**
ISBN-13: 9780930706036 and ISBN-10: 093070603X

**Publisher & Edition:**
Published by Seek It Pubns in 2015. The edition is the 2nd edition, in paperback format.

**Format & Length:**
Also available in PDF format with a print length of 315 pages, dimensions 11″ x 8.5″, with a print date of April 2018.

**About the Book:**
This book contains historically tested Solar-Lunar correlations to trading reversals in the Gold Market. These studies cover over 40 years of daily Gold prices, starting from December 31, 1974 through April 2015.

It examines over 10,000 trading days in the Gold market and identifies dates for isolated highs and lows of 3 and 4% reversals. It identifies which Solar-Lunar combinations have the highest (and lowest) correlation to these reversals, which can then be used as a leading indicator to project similar reversals in future Gold prices.

It is not limited to just solar-lunar correlations — it also contains studies on Sun/Mercury and Sun/Venus correlations to reversals in the Gold market. In addition, it provides easy-to-understand, step-by-step instructions on how to apply these market timing results in combination with proper chart set ups.

**About the Author:**
Raymond Merriman is President of Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. His monthly, weekly, and daily market reports have served traders throughout the world since 1981. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association.

He has written several books on the correlation of financial markets to geocosmic studies, including "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Prices" (1982), which was the first quantitative study conducted on the relationship of planetary mechanics to financial market prices.

He is also the author of "Secrets of a Silver Trader" (2006) and "Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics" (1994).

## Raymond Merriman – Background and Track Record

**Who is Raymond Merriman?**

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

**Education and Career:**

- Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971.
- His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles' analyst.
- Between 1982-1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).

**Market Timing Track Record:**

- In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria.
- In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

**Notable Trade Calls (from MMA's website):**

- In the MMA Weekly Report, Ray Merriman's recommendation was, "Let's go long at 1825 +/- 10 with a stop-loss on a close below 1790." Gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week. By December 4, less than two months later, it traded as high as 2152.
- One testimonial states: "Thanks to Raymond Merriman, I have closed 36 trades this year with a win rate of 86%."

**Methodology:**

He has been a market timer for independent traders since 1982, using a unique niche because two of the market timing tools he uses to identify turning points relate to cycle studies and geocosmic studies, or astrological factors. He has done extensive research on the correlation of these studies to significant highs and lows in financial markets going back to the late 1600s in British stock indices and since 1792 in the US stock market.

**Publications:**

Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Volumes 1-5 (1997-2012); The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles (1982); The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market (2006); and the annual Forecast Book (since 1976).

**Astrology Credentials:**

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972. At UAC 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award."

**Academy:**

Today, MMA has trained approximately 200 students in the MMA methodology of market analysis and timing, and now has the top ten or so working as financial market analysts, plus several editors for the annual Forecast Book, monthly, weekly, and daily services.

---

In summary, Raymond Merriman is a long-established financial market timer who combines cycle analysis with geocosmic (astrological) studies. His most notable track record achievement is winning back-to-back "Best Market Timer" Gold Star awards in 2013 and 2014 from Market Timing Digest in Amsterdam, and he has been publishing market advisory reports continuously since 1982.

## Raymond Merriman and Financial Astrology (金融占星)

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. He is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

### Background and Education
Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst.

### Financial Astrology Career
His mentorship resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles," the first book ever on quantitative studies correlating cycle highs and lows in a financial market (Gold) to planetary cycles. This also led to the immense interest in Financial Astrology, which became – and still is – one of the hottest subjects in the field of astrology.

### Awards and Recognition
At UAC (United Astrology Congress) 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award." In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S stock market well ahead of time.

In it, Merriman discusses how financial astrology studies the correlations between financial markets, economic events, and astrological factors, with particular emphasis on market timing.

## Financial Market Timing Books

1. **The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles (1982)**
   - Under Walter Bressert's tutelage, Merriman began his research on the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, which resulted in the publication of *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* in 1982 (now out-of-print).
   - This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

2. **The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Volumes 1–5 (1997–2012)**
   - From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy.
   - In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

3. **The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market (2006)**
   - Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006).

4. **Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader (2015)**

- **Publisher:** Published by Seek It Pubns in 1997.

### Book Description

This is a book about probabilities in the stock market. Specifically this book covers the entire history of the New York Stock Exchange (1789-1997) as well as the Japanese Nikkei Stock Index (1949-1997). It identifies 15 long and short-term recurrent cycles, and the types of patterns which unfold in each.

It explains not only WHEN a market is likely to form an important crest or trough, but also HOW that cycle will unfold. It outlines the bullish and bearish phases of each cycle, tells which is operative at any given point in time, and how to tie that cycle in with the larger cycles for various investing or trading strategies.

### Content Overview

This 227-page 16 chapter book provides solid evidence that cycles exist in stock prices. The book documents the cycles and patterns with 5 graphs and charts, 18 figures and diagrams, and 25 tables.

### Series Context

This book is Volume I of a 5-part series on "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing" by Raymond Merriman. From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

Originally written in 1997, with a second edition in 2005, this classic is now updated and re-written for the first time in 12 years.

## Book Details

The full title is *Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Vol 2: Geocosmic Correlations to Investment Cycles*, with ISBN-10: 0930706277 and ISBN-13: 9780930706272. It was published by Seek It Publications in 2000.

The book is 295 pages long and weighs 2.05 lbs.

## Author

Raymond A. Merriman is a market analyst and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory market letter used by financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981. Mr. Merriman has worked as an Investment Advisor for Prudential Securities and Shearson Lehman Hutton, as well as Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures for Pain Webber Inc., between 1986-1994.

## Content Overview

Stock Market Timing, Volume 2 analyzes and gives weighted values (scores) to each long-term planetary cycle, its phases (aspects), and their correlation to 50-week or greater cycles in the U.S. stock market — going all the way back to the beginning in 1789.

This is a book that correlates all geocosmic signatures involving major aspect relationships between Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto, to the intermediate and longer-term cycles in the U.S. stock market.

The book addresses key questions such as:
- Which planetary cycles correlate with the 18-year and greater stock market cycles (and hence trends)?
- Which correlate more with the four-year cycles?
- Which correlate with long-term cycle crests, and which to long-term cycle troughs?

This book not only shows the historical correspondence of long-term planetary cycles to long-term cycles in the U.S. Stock Market, but also provides an excellent model for investing based upon this knowledge. It combines the market timing techniques of cycles, as explained in Volume 1, with the market timing correlations of geocosmic time bands, to produce a very accurate method of narrowing the probable time band for long-term cycle tops and bottoms in the U.S. Stock Market.

An effective investment plan is then described for entering the stock market, to increase one's probability of capturing at least two-thirds of the bull-market move, once the timing criteria are satisfied, in each 4-year cycle.

## Part of a Larger Series

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy.

Used copies are available from US$ 240.00 on AbeBooks.

## Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

## His Approach

Merriman Market Analyst combines decades of expertise with innovative tools to give investors a unique edge in navigating financial markets. Through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, they provide resources and education to help traders make informed decisions.

As featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street, Merriman Market Analyst is the leader in market timing products and services. Since 1982, MMA has extrapolated these patterns into proprietary financial forecasting tools that deliver results.

## Weekly Blog/Forecast Reviews

Raymond Merriman publishes a free weekly forecast/blog on his website (mmacycles.com). Recent topics include market reviews covering geopolitics, U.S. stocks, and commodities. For example:

- In one review, Ray Merriman noted that U.S. stocks fell sharply, putting the Dow Jones Industrial Average in correction territory, or more than 10% off its February high.
- In another review, Merriman wrote about the absence of a coherent U.S. strategy regarding the Strait of Hormuz and how investors were likely to focus on Iranian actions as the market driver.

## Books & Education

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages. His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.

## Awards

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year," this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

## User Reviews & Ratings

On Stock Gumshoe, Merriman Market Analyst is described as providing tools that integrate a combination of cycles, geocosmic signatures, and trend analysis patterns. It has a rating of 1.7 out of 5 from 7 votes.

- One user stated: "Thanks to Raymond Merriman, I have closed 36 trades this year with a win rate of 86%."
- Another subscriber shared: "I have uncovered a passionate interest in financial market timing and astrology, and I have been able to turn my investing journey from one of stress and frustration to one of excitement and enjoyment. Reading your reports has become a highlight of my day."

## Raymond Merriman – Financial Astrology Review & Effectiveness

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. His formal education and training includes a bachelor's degree in psychology from Michigan State University, postgraduate studies in clinical psychology, and professional certification as a life member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972). He is president of Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., an investment advisory firm specializing in market timing products and services, and he is the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory newsletter used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1982.

### His Approach

Merriman Market Analyst combines decades of expertise with innovative tools, using market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis to help traders make informed decisions. His methodology focuses on the convergence of geocosmic patterns with market cycle timing. For instance, most markets have an 18-week primary cycle, and his studies show this time band can be narrowed down to three trading days or less if a strong geocosmic signature is in effect. Some geocosmic factors are labeled Levels 1, 2, or 3, depending on their historical correlation to reversals. Merriman prefers the word "forecast" to "prediction," because forecast refers to probabilities—identifying those time bands with the highest probability for market cycle completions, which he says is the basis for a "higher-than-average accuracy in forecasting market turns."

### Awards and Recognition

In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time. He is a Professional Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers, and in 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

### Claims of Effectiveness

**From Merriman and his supporters:**
- Merriman claims: "It works! Nothing is as consistently accurate in identifying reversal times in financial markets as astrology."
- A subscriber testimonial on MMA's website states: "Thanks to Raymond Merriman, I have closed 36 trades this year with a win rate of 86%. Ray's predictive ability is remarkable. No one predicts more accurately."
- As early as 1994, Merriman began warning that a huge stock market decline and financial crisis would upset the global economy in 2008, based on the angular relationship between transiting Saturn and Uranus.

**Notable trade examples highlighted by MMA:**
- The MMA Weekly Report recommended going long gold at 1825 +/- 10, and gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week. Less than two months later, it traded as high as 2152.

### Skepticism and Criticism

Skeptics on trading forums have questioned: "Is this Mr. Merriman's first such prediction? And how many weeks has he been calling this? Can you confirm what other key reversals he has called in the past, or do you just keep a record of the successes?" This highlights the concern about **confirmation bias** — whether only successful predictions are remembered and promoted while failed ones are overlooked.

Merriman himself acknowledged that challenging aspects between Saturn, Uranus, and Pluto in 2010 and 2014 were expected to bring more bad news, but the largest market intervention in world history by central bank policymakers nullified this possibility, with the Fed lowering interest rates and buying securities, causing stocks to soar to record highs. This admission suggests that external economic policy can override astrological predictions.

Other traders have countered that traditional technical analysis tools like candlestick patterns can provide the same timing signals without resorting to astrology, arguing that chart signals already incorporate all trader sentiments and behavioral patterns.

### Cost

Merriman's two-year Market Timing Academy program, which launched in April 2013, costs $20,000. He also offers daily, weekly, and monthly subscription reports at various price points.

### Bottom Line

Raymond Merriman is one of the most prominent figures in financial astrology, with decades of experience and some documented successful market timing calls. However, independent, peer-reviewed verification of the consistent effectiveness of financial astrology as a market timing tool remains lacking. His approach blends traditional cycle analysis with astrological timing, and while supporters point to specific impressive calls, critics note the risk of survivorship bias and the challenge of distinguishing astrological correlations from coincidence. As with any market timing system, prospective users should exercise caution and conduct thorough due diligence.

## Raymond A. Merriman — Background and Publications

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

### Education
Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971.

### Early Career & Research Model
Before entering financial markets, he worked as a project coordinator for an adolescent group program with the Michigan Department of Social Services, where he developed a group counseling model known as "RGD" (Reference Group Dynamics). This model was later adopted by high schools in Ohio and Michigan in the 1970's.

### Key Published Works
Rather than traditional peer-reviewed academic papers, Merriman's body of work consists primarily of **books and research publications** in the field of financial market timing and geocosmic studies:

- He is the author of *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope* (1977), *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through States of* (1992), and *The Solar Return Book of Prediction* (1977).
- *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing* is a basic textbook on the relationship of geocosmic correlations to financial markets.
- Under Walter Bressert's tutelage, Merriman began his research in the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, which resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles," in 1982. This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.
- From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

### Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)
In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects identifying historical correlations between the analysis methods and historical performance.

### Awards
- In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013."
- In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest.
- At UAC (United Astrology Congress) 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." At UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award."

### Summary
No traditional peer-reviewed academic papers by Raymond Merriman were found in the search results. His published works are primarily **self-published books, market advisory newsletters, and research studies** focused on the intersection of cycles analysis, geocosmic (astrological) correlations, and financial market timing. His research is conducted and published through his own organization (MMA) rather than through academic journals.

### About the Book

This is the long-awaited last volume of this five-volume series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*. The first volume was released in 1997, and all four of the prior volumes focused on market timing: WHEN to buy or sell. This book now provides the final part, the missing link: WHERE — at what price — to buy or sell.

## Raymond Merriman's Market Timing Academy (MMTA) — Video Course Recordings

### Overview

Raymond Merriman is the founder of Merriman Market Analyst, Inc (MMA) and the Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA). The MMTA is described as a comprehensive two-year virtual program designed to equip students with expert knowledge of market timing and financial analysis.

### MMTA Program Structure

This is a two-year program in the MMA Market Timing methodology. The program is made up of eight individual courses, each taught in 6–7 classes via Zoom, lasting 2–3 hours each and containing 2–3 lessons per class.

The purpose is to teach one the methodology of analyzing financial markets and to train students in market timing skills, according to the studies developed by Raymond Merriman since 1980. Graduates receive certificates of completion recognized in the field as a solid grounding as a market analyst specializing in market timing.

### Video Recordings Availability

Each class will be recorded and students will have access to review the video recording of the classes at any time. The classes are offered live online via Zoom, and each class will be recorded and made available to access through the website portal by the following Monday.

Purchase of MMTA3 Course Three, for example, includes live access to five classes as well as all five class video recordings, the Course Three workbook, 14 lesson presentations, and chat transcripts from live classes.

### MMTA Versions

- **MMTA (Original):** The first workshop course on "Cycles and Chart Patterns in Financial Markets" was held April 6–8, 2013. A recording from April 8, 2013, the last day of Course One of the MMTA in Troy, Michigan, is available on YouTube.

- **MMTA2:** MMTA2 Course 1 Recordings cover "Cycles and Chart Patterns in Financial Markets." Each class session was recorded, and all students have access to review the video recording of the classes at any time.

- **MMTA3:** The course is taught by Gianni Di Poce, MMTA Program Director, with assistance from Raymond Merriman, as well as both Merriman and Di Poce together.

- **MMTA4:** The program is led by both Raymond Merriman and Wiebke Held (MMTA Program Director), along with MMA faculty including Gianni Di Poce, Wyatt Fellows, Pouyan Zolfagharnia, Derek Panaia, Rita Perea, and Kat Powell. MMTA4 dates begin September 27, 2025.

### Pricing (MMTA Recordings)

The cost for each course is $1,800 (7 classes per course, approximately 15 hours of recordings per course). The entire 4-course recordings are available for a discounted price of $6,600 (saving $600).

### Course Topics Include

Over eight structured courses, students explore leading indicators such as financial market cycles, geocosmic correlations to long-, intermediate-, and short-term market cycles, as well as advanced technical analysis methods, including price objectives calculations, chart patterns, and support and resistance calculations. The program equips students with the skills to accurately forecast market reversals, write market reports, and derive and execute investment and trading strategies, with extensive practical exercises and real-world applications.

### Contact & More Info

For additional information, email: mmta@mmacycles.com.
