## Raymond Merriman's Books & Japanese Editions

### About the Author

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

### Translations and International Editions

His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.

### *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics* — Japanese Edition

*Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics* was first published in 1994. The Japanese edition is available as a Kindle eBook on Amazon, titled **相場サイクルの基本 メリマンサイクル論**.

The Japanese Edition was authored by Raymond A Merriman, with Hiroyuki Minagawa (皆川弘之) as the translator.

This newly rewritten book is not only an excellent learning tool for trading with the use of cycle studies, but also an excellent reference book on several original financial market cycles. Scores of new cycles have been added to the original work, covering the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P, NASDAQ, Japan Nikkei, Shanghai Composite, and many other global indices, currencies, and commodities.

### Other Key Books by Raymond Merriman

He is the author of "Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics" (1994), "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing Volume 1: Cycles and Patterns in the Indexes" (1997), "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing Volume 2: Geocosmic Correlation to Investment Cycles" (2001), and "The Sun, The Moon, and the Silver Market: Secrets of a Silver Trader" (1992).

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

### Japanese Edition Translators & Publishers

Based on Amazon Japan listings, two main translators have been involved with the Japanese editions:

1. **皆川弘之 (Hiroyuki Minagawa)** — Translated *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics* (相場サイクルの基本) and other earlier works. Works by レイモンド・A・メリマン and 皆川弘之 appear on Amazon Japan, including editions from December 2009.

2. **秋山日瑶香 (Hiyoka Akiyama)** — Has translated several Japanese editions of Merriman's annual publications. Multiple Kindle editions by レイモンド・A・メリマン and 秋山日瑶香 are available, spanning from 2015 through 2021, published through Amazon Services International LLC.

### Annual Forecast Books — Japanese Edition

In addition to the English edition, Raymond Merriman has written special yearly market reports/forecasts for the Japanese Nikkei, which are translated and printed in the Japanese edition of the Forecast books.

Each foreign edition of the Forecast book includes a stock market section specific to that nation, which is not included in the English Forecast book or in other international editions. The overseas market reports available separately in English include Japan's Nikkei, China's Shanghai Composite, and Germany's DAX plus Zurich's SMI indices.

The Japanese edition of the annual Forecast appears to be published through **投資日報出版 (Toshi Nippou Shuppan)**. For example, "MUNDANE2020: 2020MUNDANE by Raymond A Merriman (TOSHINIPPOU SHUPPAN) (Japanese Edition)" was published on March 30, 2020.

### Summary of Known Japanese-Edition Titles

| Title (English) | Japanese Title | Translator |
|---|---|---|
| Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics | 相場サイクルの基本 メリマンサイクル論 | 皆川弘之 (Hiroyuki Minagawa) |
| Annual Forecast series (various years) | フォーキャスト (various years) | 秋山日瑶香 (Hiyoka Akiyama) |
| Mundane 2020 | マンデーン2020 | 秋山日瑶香 (Hiyoka Akiyama) |
| Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies | (Japanese edition available) | — |

As of the 2026 edition, this marks MMA's 50th Annual Forecast Book. The Forecast series has been a cornerstone of Merriman's publications, with Japanese editions published regularly for the Japanese market.

## Raymond Merriman — Translated & Non-English Materials

### Languages of Publication

Raymond Merriman's works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English. This means his materials are available in **11 languages**, with 10 of those being non-English.

### Background on His Body of Work

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

In addition, he has also written two primers on financial market analysis: *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics*, first published in 1994, and *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing*, a basic textbook on the relationship of geocosmic correlations to financial markets.

### Specific Non-English Editions Found

1. **Japanese**: A Japanese Edition of *Merriman on Market Cycles: Basics on Market Cycles* is available as a Kindle eBook, authored by Raymond A. Merriman and translated by Hiroyuki Minagawa. Additionally, *MUNDANE2020: 2020MUNDANE* was published by TOSHINIPPOU SHUPPAN as a Japanese Edition in March 2020.

2. **German**: German-language editions are available, published by Bod - Books on Demand, 2022. German titles listed include *Das große Jahreshoroskop 2022* and *Das große Jahreshoroskop 2023* (annual horoscope forecasts).

3. **Italian**: An Italian edition titled *Astrologia evolutiva: Il viaggio dell'anima attraverso gli stati di coscienza* was published by Crisalide in 1994. An Italian Edition is also listed on Amazon, dated December 1, 1994.

4. **German (Everand bio)**: He is described as the President and founder of "The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc." and his annual forecast book and market reports are translated into multiple languages.

### His International Standing

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

He also served seven non-consecutive terms as President of ISAR (the International Society for Astrological Research), a decision reached in a two-step process involving over 1500 members from over 25 national centers around the world.

## About Raymond Merriman & MMA

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Volumes 1–5 (1997–2012); *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982); *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006); and the annual Forecast Book (since 1976).

In 2013, he created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology. At present, several of the graduates are now market analysts with MMA.

---

## Free Resources on mmacycles.com

### Free Weekly Column & Forecasts
The Weekly Forecasts Archive on mmacycles.com features columns contributed by Raymond Merriman and guest analysts. You can sign up to have the weekly forecast delivered directly to your inbox, FREE.

### Free Weekly Column Podcast
MMA's Free Weekly Column Podcast is available on Spotify, Apple, and Amazon. You can listen to a podcast of the weekly column by Thomas Miller on Saturdays. Just follow Merriman Market Analyst on Spotify or Apple to listen to all episodes. A new podcast episode is released every weekend. This is a FREE service and is available to everyone.

### Articles
The Articles section on mmacycles.com includes an interview with Ray Merriman written by Shreekala Ram, featured in Joni Patry's Astrology Insights. Other articles explore topics like the financial markets as a dynamic landscape and the concept of position trading and its significance.

---

## YouTube Channel

The Merriman Market Analyst YouTube channel offers content on Financial Astrology, along with links to the Free Weekly Forecast at mmacycles.com.

There is also a YouTube playlist titled "Saturday Financial Episodes: Ray Merriman's Free MMAcycles.com Newsletter," featuring Financial Astrology & Commentary with Ray Merriman.

---

## Additional Products & Events

- **Jupiter Report**: The Jupiter Report is written by Raymond Merriman. It is a 30- to 40-page report that identifies the times during the year when Jupiter transits are highlighted in your natal chart and explains the meaning of Jupiter's transits to your natal planets and angles over a 14-month period.

- **Solar-Lunar App**: The MMA Solar-Lunar App offers reversal signals for the DJIA, NASDAQ, Gold, and Silver. It is an ideal tool for short-term swing traders looking for high-probability dates that identify isolated lows and highs. It works best as an adjunct tool when cycle lows or highs are due. The app is currently available only on Apple devices.

- **Upcoming Event**: On September 3, 2026, Raymond Merriman will present a pre-conference workshop on Financial Astrology at the United Astrology Congress (UAC), the largest astrological conference in the world, held at the Marriott Downtown Chicago Magnificent Mile Hotel.

- **Geocosmic Studies Course**: Recordings of MMA's special six-week course on "The Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing" are available, led by Gianni Di Poce and supported by Ray Merriman.

---

## Merriman MMTA International Cycles Report (ICR) — Subscription Pricing

### What is the ICR?

MMTA graduates have launched the MMTA International Cycles Report (ICR), covering many international stock and commodity markets. The original graduates, now known as Apprentices, are doing internship by analyzing international markets for this new market letter, the MMTA International Cycles Report. It is a monthly subscription report overseen by Merriman, that started in early 2015.

### Pricing Found

Based on the MMA website (from a 2019 product listing), the ICR was offered as two separate monthly subscriptions:

- **MMTA Monthly International Cycles Report: Financials** — **$35**
- **MMTA Monthly International Cycles Report: Commodities** — **$35**

### Additional Context

Several of the MMTA graduates are now market analysts with MMA, analyzing various international markets for "The MMA Cycles Report" as well as "The MMTA International Cycles Report" (ICR).

For example, analyst Gianni Di Poce reports on T-Notes for the MMA Monthly Cycles Report, as well as the Australian markets (index and currency), Cannabis, and Live Cattle for the International Cycles Reports.

Analyst Ulric Aspegrén is a market timer analyst specialized on currencies and reports on the Euro for the monthly MMA Monthly Cycles Report. He also covers the U.S. Dollar Index and the British Pound in the MMTA Monthly International Cycles Report.

### Note
The $35/month per report pricing was found from a 2019 listing on mmacycles.com. Current pricing may have changed. Here is a comprehensive summary of **Raymond Merriman's FAR (Financial Astrological Research) for Galactic Trader software** — an astrology-based trading tool:

---

## Overview

In conjunction with PAS, Inc., Merriman has developed a financial astrological software system: The FAR (Financial Astrological Research) for the Galactic Trader program, which enables traders to identify potential turning points in various stocks and/or financial futures markets.

Galactic Trader, by Jeanne Long, is designed to meet the needs of traders and researchers of all levels of planetary knowledge, performing basic planetary Harmonic Price Analysis on any market in any time frame.

## What FAR Does

The FAR program includes solar/lunar weighted values calculations for the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Gold, and Silver as reported in Ray Merriman's books — *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, *Solar/Lunar Keys to Gold Prices: Secrets of a Gold Trader*, and *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market: Secrets of a Silver Trader*.

FAR for the Galactic Trader is described as "the perfect blend of advanced windows-based technology, sophisticated market timing tools, and the most popular technical studies."

## Key Features

- **Filtered Wave Research:** Allows the user to instantly isolate highs and lows of a user-defined percentage move, then perform a quantitative or weighted value analysis of geocosmic factors that were in effect at those times, revealing which factors have an unusually high or low historical rate of occurrence to reversals.

- **Create Your Own Research:** Allows the user to manually isolate any lows or highs they think are important; the program then performs a quantitative or weighted value analysis of geocosmic factors, revealing which geocosmic combinations have an unusually high historical rate of occurrence.

- **Big Range Days / Volatility Studies:** Allows the user to instantly identify specific dates that have been "big range days" and then performs a weighted value analysis of geocosmic factors to reveal which combinations have an unusually high rate of occurrence to "big range days" in the future.

- **MMA Solar/Lunar Weighted Values:** With this feature, one can select any date on the calendar and the solar/lunar values for reversals in the DJIA, Gold, and Silver market will pop up, based on reversals of 4% or more.

- **Data Compatibility:** Price charts can be created from well-known data vendors like CSI, Metastock, Computrac, TC-2000, Signal, S&P Comstock, Reuters, Knight-Ridder, Bloomberg, Quote.com, and most others.

- **Technical Studies:** Tools include Planetary Lines, Aspect Research, Ephemeris, Live Planetary Clock, Natal Chart List, Expanded Universal Clock, and now Asteroids and Transneptunians.

| **Galactic Trader EOD Version 4.10** (without FAR) | **$895.00** |

The access fee of $29/year is included for the first year.

## Delivery

Buyers get immediate access to a downloadable FAR manual PDF, with the software download available within 48 hours after the order is placed.

## About Raymond Merriman

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. He is president of Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., an investment advisory firm specializing in market timing products and services, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory newsletter used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1982.

## Raymond Merriman – Trading Methodology Overview

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

His introduction to financial markets began in 1978. Two years later, he became a student of Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst in commodities. Under Walter's tutelage, Merriman began his research on the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market, based on Walter's methodology of cycles analysis.

### Core Methodology: How Buy/Sell Signals Are Generated

Merriman's methodology integrates multiple layers of analysis to generate trading signals:

1. **Cycle Analysis (Timing):** First, the system looks for the geocosmic signature that is unfolding – if there is one. These are the criteria used for identifying a time band of importance to trade. These are described as "triggers or leading indicators" in the methodology.

2. **Technical Confirmation:** Then, supporting indicators of a reversal setup are assessed. These are more like coincident indicators, such as a chart pattern or for a price target range to be met. They may even look for a technical momentum indicator of overbought/oversold to support that a change in trend is ready.

3. **Signal Execution:** When all – or several – of these conditions are in place, the buy or sell signal in their strategy to subscribers is enacted.

### The Methodology in Full: "The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing" (5 Volumes)

This publication completed a project that started in 1996, covering approximately 1,600 pages of studies and strategies for all types of traders and investors, using their market timing methods. In all, it is a complete and unified approach to analyzing (and trading) financial markets, and especially stock indices.

- **Volumes 1–4** focus on **timing**: The previous 4 volumes have been on "when" to buy and sell, or how to forecast a future cycle low or high.
- **Volume 5** focuses on **price targets**: This last volume addresses the subject of "where" to buy and sell, or at what price to buy and sell. It is the art and science of "forecasting price targets" — the missing link to the first four volumes. It details the mathematical formulas and technical studies used to enhance timing of entry and exit in any market, but especially stock indices.

### Key Analytical Tools

The system combines innovative market timing solutions leveraging a combination of advanced analytical methodologies. Through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, MMA provides resources and education to help traders make informed decisions.

Volume 5 of the book series describes in detail how to calculate each cycle's support/resistance levels, bullish/bearish crossover zones, and trend indicators.

### The Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)

In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, a two-year training course in his market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects identifying historical correlations between the analysis methods and historical performance. These courses are now available to new students for online learning. The original graduates have been trained to become financial market analysts utilizing the MMA methodology.

### Recognition

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market.

---

In summary, Merriman's trading system is a multi-layered approach combining **cycle analysis** (including geocosmic/planetary cycles), **technical chart patterns**, **price target calculations**, and **momentum indicators** to generate buy and sell signals. His five-volume book series provides the complete methodology, and his subscription reports (daily, weekly, and monthly) deliver actionable trading signals based on this system.

## MMA Cycles Report – Overview & Review

### What It Is
The MMA Cycles Report is a monthly newsletter, with occasional special updates, written by Raymond Merriman and used by banks, financial institutions, investors and traders throughout the world since 1981. The monthly MMA Cycles Report is one of the most insightful, reliable, and usable market letters in existence today – and it has been for over 35 years!

### Markets Covered
Each issue provides an in-depth cyclical and technical analysis of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P, gold, silver, Treasury Notes, Euro currency, Swiss Franc, corn, soybeans, wheat, and crude oil, with projections of futures trends, price targets and reversal dates.

### Methodology
The report uses a unique combination of three analytical approaches:
- These tools integrate a combination of Cycles, Geocosmic Signatures, and Trend Analysis patterns that assist the serious investor in interpreting the markets.
- Geocosmics is the study of correspondences between cycles of human activity and the cycles of the planets. Yes, this is astrology. And while many will immediately write this off as too unconventional for serious consideration, the open-minded will find astonishing correlations between certain planetary alignments and significant stock market movements. One cannot argue the high rates of frequency of these connections.

### Key Features
- Each issue contains MMA's proprietary CRDs (Critical Reversal Dates) that are in effect for the next month (usually 1-3 dates).
- Each report also comes with at least 12 charts (weekly and daily) of the markets being analyzed.
- Each issue also provides a list of critical reversal dates for all financial markets based on geocosmic studies and methods published in Merriman's *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* series, published in four volumes (1997-2006).

### The Team
Analysts include Ray Merriman (Review and Preview, Key Points), Gianni Di Poce (DJIA, S&P, T-Notes, SMI), Wyatt Fellows (Soybeans, Gold), Pouyan Zolfagharnia (Copper, Crude Oil, Silver), and Ulric Aspegren (Euro).

### About the Editor
Between 1982-1986 Mr. Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network. He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities and Shearson Lehman Hutton, before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber. He has passed both the Series 3 and 7 exams for Commodities, Financial Futures, Securities and Investments, and is registered as a Commodities Trading Advisor through the National Futures Association.

### History
The first issue of the MMA Cycles Report started out with 35 subscribers. After one year, the MMA Cycles Report grew from 35 to 350 subscribers, MMA was incorporated, and Merriman became a CTA registered with the National Futures Association.

### Notable Claims
- The same planetary movements that accompanied the Great Depression were at work again (80 years later) in the stock market collapse and the recession that followed. Merriman first forecast the crisis in 1994 – 14 years before it happened! It was discussed in every MMA annual Forecast Book from 1994 through 2008.
- It provides the three-star critical reversal dates for each market for the year, which have an 80+% accuracy over the years to trading cycle highs and lows when given an orb of three trading days.

### Additional Products
- The MMA Monthly Cycles Report Plus+, edited by Pouyan Zolfagharnia, has become a very popular addition to the MMA Cycles Report (it's less technical, more visual, and contains horoscopes of current importance, high-quality analysis, and updates on MMA Cycles Report markets).
- For more advanced traders, MMA also offers weekly and daily subscription services.

### Publication Schedule (2026)
MMA Monthly Cycles Report Schedule: February 9, 2026, March 9, 2026, April 13, 2026, May 11, 2026, June 8, 2026.

---

**Summary:** The MMA Cycles Report is a long-standing financial market advisory newsletter that uniquely blends traditional technical and cycle analysis with astrological/geocosmic studies. It has a devoted following among both individual traders and institutional investors. While its astrological methodology may be unconventional, the report has maintained a subscriber base for over 40 years and claims a strong track record of identifying market reversal dates.

## Background & Credentials

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. His formal education and training includes a bachelor's degree in psychology (Michigan State University, 1969); postgraduate studies in clinical psychology; professional (certified) life member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972); and commodities trading advisor (CTA, 1982).

## His Approach to Financial Astrology

## Raymond Merriman and Financial Astrology

### Who is Raymond Merriman?

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. His formal education includes a bachelor's degree in psychology from Michigan State University (1969), postgraduate studies in clinical psychology, certification as a commodities trading advisor (CTA, 1982), and series 3 and 7 exams for commodities, financial futures, securities, and investments.

Currently, Merriman is president of the Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., an investment advisory firm specializing in market timing products and services. He is the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory newsletter used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1982.

### His Methodology

Merriman's arsenal seamlessly integrates Cycles, Geocosmic Signatures, and Trend Analysis patterns, combining astrology with traditional technical analysis. The course covers the planetary rulers of various economic sectors and financial markets, offering practical insight into how cosmic cycles influence economic behavior.

A cycle of 6 weeks has been identified by both Bressert and Merriman in precious metals, and by Merriman in stock prices, Corn, Wheat, and Soybean prices.

### Claims of Effectiveness

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded recognition as he was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest.

As early as 1994, financial astrologer Ray Merriman began persistently warning that a huge stock market decline and financial crisis would upset the global economic applecart in 2008. His prediction was largely based on the angular relationship between transiting Saturn and Uranus — a 180-degree opposition aspect.

One testimonial on his website states: "Thanks to Raymond Merriman, I have closed 36 trades this year with a win rate of 86%. Ray's predictive ability is remarkable. No one predicts more accurately."

### Published Works

Merriman has authored nearly 50 books involving astrology. The financial series started with *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycle* in 1982 and culminated with a five-volume series entitled *The Ultimate Book of Stock Market Timing*, totaling about 1,600 pages.

### Academic Research Referencing Merriman

There is research examining the effect of astrology with reversals on Gold, namely Merriman (2015). Merriman defines a reversal as a day where there is an increase or decrease of more than equal to 4% of the low. This study examines financial analysis methods based on Astrology, Fibonacci, and Astronacci to find JCI reversal dates and future Gold prices. However, this approach "has not been recognized by most scientists, especially in Indonesia."

### Skepticism and Caveats

It's important to note that:

- The claims of effectiveness largely come from Merriman's own organization and client testimonials, which are inherently self-promotional.
- Some skeptics note that "doubtless there are some astrologers who have mastered this but future success for them depends on keeping the method to themselves."
- Merriman himself admits that challenging planetary aspects between 2010 and 2014 were expected to bring bad news, but the largest market intervention in world history by central bank policymakers nullified this possibility, and the stock market soared to record highs instead.
- Mainstream financial science generally does not accept astrological methods as valid predictive tools for markets, and there is no peer-reviewed evidence establishing a causal mechanism between planetary positions and stock prices.

In summary, Merriman is the most prominent figure in financial astrology with a significant following and some notable claimed market calls, but independent, rigorous verification of the overall effectiveness of his astrological market timing methods remains lacking.

## Raymond A. Merriman — Astrologer & Financial Market Analyst

Raymond Merriman is a contemporary astrologer best known for his work in the astrology of the stock market. This information comes from *The Astrology Book, Second Edition* © 2003, published by Visible Ink Press.

### Early Life & Education
Raymond A. Merriman was born on December 25, 1946. His formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology from Michigan State University in 1969, and he did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University from 1969 to 1971.

### Career
An American professional astrologer since 1968, he is a publisher, author, and commodities specialist. He founded the Aquarian Revelation Center in 1972, Seek-It Publications in 1977, and the Merriman Market Analyst in 1981.

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst.

Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

### Awards & Recognition
In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." In 2014 he received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year," this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

He also served seven non-consecutive terms as President of ISAR (the International Society for Astrological Research).

### Publications
Merriman is an international lecturer on both financial market cycles and various aspects of astrology as it applies to cycles in human activity. His key works include:

- *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope* (1977), *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through States of Consciousness* (1992), and *The Solar Return Book of Prediction* (1977).
- *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Vol. 1: Cycles and Patterns in the Indexes (1997), Vol. 2: Geocosmic Correlations to Investment Cycles (1999), and Vol. 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles (2001).

### Software & Tools
In conjunction with PAS, Inc., Merriman also developed a financial astrological software system: The FAR (Financial Astrological Research) for the Galactic Trader program, which enables traders to identify potential turning points in various stocks and/or financial futures markets.

### Current Residence
Raymond Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

## Raymond Merriman's Annual Forecast Book

### Origins and History

Raymond Merriman authored several books on Financial Market Timing, including the annual Forecast Book (since 1976), which outlines his projections a year ahead of time for financial markets, the world economy, and political trends.

MMA's annual Forecasts Book, written by Raymond A. Merriman since 1976, is "one of the most unique, affordable, and accurate glimpses into the coming year." Utilizing the study of cycles and geocosmic factors, this annual Forecasts book outlines forthcoming trends pertaining to political, economic, and financial markets throughout the world. This is described as a book with an impressive history of insightful accuracy.

### About the Author

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982. He also writes daily and weekly reports for more active traders.

Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969-1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles' analyst. Under Bressert's tutelage, Merriman began his research in the correlation of planetary cycles to cycles in the Gold market.

### Other Major Works

Merriman is also the author of several other books on Financial Market Timing, including The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Volumes 1–5 (1997-2012); The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles (1982); The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market (2006); and Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader (2015).

In addition, he has written two primers on financial market analysis: *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics*, first published in 1994, and *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing*, a basic textbook on geocosmic correlations to financial markets.

### Professional Career

- Between 1982-1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN).
- He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).
- He is a Professional (Certified) Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972).

### Key Takeaway

The earliest edition of the annual **Forecast Book** dates back to **1976**, making it one of the longest-running annual financial market forecasting publications. He is the author of the annual Forecasts Book since 1976. This means the series has been published continuously for approximately 50 years.

## Book Details

**Title:** The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Volume 5: Technical Analysis and Price Objectives
**Author:** Raymond Merriman
**Format:** Paperback
**Print Length:** 300 pages
**Dimensions:** 11″ x 8.5″
**Print Date:** October 2012

## Overview

This is the long-awaited last volume of this five-volume series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*. The previous 4 volumes have been on "when" to buy and sell, or how to forecast a future cycle low or high. This last volume addresses the subject of "where" to buy and sell, or at what price to buy and sell. It is the art and science of "forecasting price targets" — the missing link to the first four volumes.

It details the mathematical formulas and technical studies used to enhance timing of entry and exit in any market, but especially stock indices.

This book delves into the 300+ year charts of the US and British stock markets to examine the percentages of gains and declines in long-term cycles. It shows the importance of combining multiple time frames, or multiple cycle lengths, to establish an understanding of longer-term trends. It defines support and resistance of long-term and shorter-term cycles using a variety of mathematical calculations based on market symmetry. It defines the three basic chart patterns within all cycles, and how to forecast the time bands and price targets for the troughs and crests of the phases within each cycle.

## The Complete Series

From 1997 through 2012, Merriman wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

## About the Author

Raymond A. Merriman is a market analyst and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory market letter issued 12 times per year, and used by financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981. He also issues a weekly and daily market report, with recommendations on the stock market, precious metals, currencies, crude oil, U.S. Treasuries, and grain markets.

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." In 2014, Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

## Raymond Merriman — Books & International Translations

### About the Author
Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

### Major Works
He authored several books on Financial Market Timing, including the five-part series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing* (1997–2012), *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006), *Solar/Lunar Keys to Gold Price Reversals* (2015), and the annual *Forecast Book* (since 1976), which outlines his projections a year ahead of time for financial markets, the world economy, and political trends.

In addition, he has also written two primers on financial market analysis: *Merriman on Market Cycles: The Basics*, first published in 1994, and *Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing*, a basic textbook on the relationship of geocosmic correlations to financial markets.

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1,600 pages.

His earliest work was *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles*, published in 1982 (now out of print). This was the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market to cycles in the cosmos.

### Translations / International Editions
His works are currently published in **German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.**

Specific translated editions that have been identified include:

- **Italian Edition**: *Astrologia Evolutiva: Il Viaggio dell'Anima attraverso gli Stati della Coscienza* (Italian Edition), published Nov 6, 2017. An earlier Italian softcover edition was also published by Crisalide in 1994 (ISBN 9788871830292).

- **German Edition**: A German Edition by Raymond A. Merriman was published on Dec 20, 2018. German-language copies are also widely available through sellers in Germany (per AbeBooks listings).

- **Japanese Edition**: *MUNDANE2020: 2020MUNDANE* by Raymond A Merriman (TOSHINIPPOU SHUPPAN) was published as a Japanese Edition on Mar 30, 2020.

- His annual forecast book and market reports are also translated into multiple languages, as noted in his German-language bio: "Sein jährliches Voraussagen-Buch sowie seine Börsenreports werden in mehrere Sprachen übersetzt" (his annual forecast book and market reports are translated into multiple languages).

### Awards & Recognition
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market.

Raymond Merriman has 33 books on Goodreads with 314 ratings.

In summary, Merriman's financial and astrological works have achieved broad international reach, with confirmed editions in **Russian, Italian, Dutch, French, German, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese**, and English.

### About the Column

The purpose of this column is not to forecast the future movement of various financial markets — that is the purpose of the MMA subscription services. The column is not a subscription service. This weekly report is written with the intent of educating the reader on the relationship between astrological factors and collective human activities as they occur.

- Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report since 1982.

- MMA continues to publish the annual MMA Forecast Book every December, which has been MMA's most popular book since 1976.

- The weekly column is also available as a podcast narrated by Thomas Miller on Saturdays. Thomas brings the weekly column to life in a personable and humorous fashion. New episodes are released every weekend as a free service on Spotify, Apple, and Amazon Music.

## Geocosmic Terminology by Raymond Merriman (mmacycles.com)

The primary resource found is the **Geocosmic Terminology** page on the MMA website ([mmacycles.com/resources/geocosmic-terminology/](https://www.mmacycles.com/resources/geocosmic-terminology/)).

### Key Concepts Explained

A common misconception about Financial Astrology, or Geocosmic Studies, is that these studies provide "fortune-telling" qualities — that if one knows astrology, one knows the future. However, Astrology, or Geocosmic Studies, by itself does not have that capability.

What geocosmic studies do provide is a high degree of accuracy in pinpointing a reversal to the trend in effect going into certain dates. The key words are *trend* and *reversal of trend* — geocosmics alone cannot tell you what the trend is.

### Star Ratings for Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs)

Dates followed by three (3) stars have the highest probability of correlating to primary cycles in financial markets, based on historical studies of geocosmic signatures. A two-star critical reversal date has a high correlation to half or full primary cycles, while a one-star has a greater correlation to major or half-primary cycle types.

One must know where a market is in terms of its primary cycle. If a primary cycle is not due, then even a three-star will not produce such a cycle. On the other hand, if a primary cycle is due, then even a one-star may produce it.

### Level 1, 2, and 3 Signatures

Two or three-star critical reversal dates means there is at least one geocosmic signature nearby that is a "Level One" type.

Some geocosmic factors are stronger than others, which MMA labels Levels 1, 2, or 3, depending on their historical correlation to reversals.

### Work in Probabilities

Market analysis and market timing is an ever-evolving work, dependent upon the ever-changing conditions and performance of the market. MMA's work is "a work in probabilities, not inevitabilities."

## Raymond Merriman's Yearly Jupiter Report

The Yearly Jupiter Report is the newest personal astrology report by Raymond Merriman, programmed by Kevin DeCapite of Luna Astrology software. The completed PDF report is delivered via email.

### What the Report Covers

Raymond Merriman's latest personal astrology report is essential for traders, as it details specific time periods when Jupiter's aspects to one's natal planets and angles can influence financial outcomes. Favorable aspects suggest success and opportunities, while challenging aspects could lead to poor decisions and potential losses. By anticipating these influences, traders can take preventive steps to maximize gains and avoid setbacks.

The report spans 14 months, starting from the month before the order is placed, and provides detailed insights into Jupiter's movements through one's astrological chart. The report is about 30–40 pages long and explains each Jupiter aspect, its duration, and its psychological and financial impact. It also offers a **Trading Rating** from **-3 to +3** for each aspect. This rating helps predict the potential for financial gains or losses.

### Important Disclosure

As a disclosure, this report only deals with Jupiter transits. It does not cover Saturn or outer planets in transit to the natal points, which can alter the Jupiter interpretation if and when they overlap. Even so, if under a hard transit from other planets, a favorable transit from Jupiter can offer a period of gain in the midst of the other challenges taking place.

### About Raymond Merriman

Raymond Merriman has served the astrological community for over 50 years. He passed the AFA Professional Astrological exam in 1972, at the time (and maybe still) the youngest person ever to do so.

He served as ISAR president from 1994–2000, 2002–2008, and 2015–2017. He also served on the UAC Board of Directors from 1995–2002.

In 1977, he published *Evolutionary Astrology*, the first introduction of this school of thought to the community of astrologers. In the same year he also published *The Solar Return Book of Prediction*.

In 1981, he founded the Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., described as the world leader in financial market timing products and services. In 2013, he launched the Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA), an intensive two-year program to train financial market analysts.

### Additional Background

Merriman is an international lecturer on both financial market cycles and various aspects of astrology as it applies to cycles in human activity.

In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013," being the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market. In 2014, he received the Gold Star award again, correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates.

Raymond Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA.

---

## Raymond Merriman 简介与评价

### 身份与职业背景

Raymond A. Merriman 是 The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. 的总裁及 Merriman Market Timing Academy 的创始人。他是一名注册商品交易顾问（CTA）、金融市场分析师，同时也是 MMA Cycles Report 的编辑。该月度市场咨询通讯自1982年以来专注于股票、利率、货币、贵金属、原油和大豆等领域。

### 教育背景

Merriman 于1969年在密歇根州立大学获得心理学文学学士学位，之后在1969至1971年期间于密歇根州立大学和奥克兰大学进行心理学研究生学习。

### 金融从业经历

1982至1986年间，Merriman 是 Financial News Network（FNN）的常客嘉宾。他曾在 Prudential Securities 担任投资执行官，在 E.F. Hutton（后为 Shearson Lehman Hutton）任职，后来成为 Paine Webber 零售商品期货的客户副总裁（1990-1994年）。

### 占星学声誉

Merriman 也是一位知名的专业占星师，自1967年开始研究占星学，并于1972年获得美国占星师联合会（AFA）的专业认证。

在1995年的联合占星大会（UAC）上，他获得了 Regulus 奖（"提升占星学作为职业的形象"），并在2012年获得了 Regulus "终身成就奖"。他还曾在1994-2000年、2002-2008年和2015-2017年期间担任国际占星研究学会（ISAR）主席。

### 著作评价

在 Goodreads 上，Raymond Merriman 的作品平均评分为 4.19 星（共26个评分，2条评论）。

他的著作《The Sun, the Moon, and Silver Market: Secrets of a Silver Trader》于2006年出版，在书籍评分中获得了5.0的总体评分。

### 行业影响力

他的 MMA Cycles Report 是一份自1982年以来被全球银行、金融机构、投资者和交易员使用的咨询通讯。

如今，已有数千名专业和独立交易者使用他所开发的方法来制定交易和投资计划。MMA（Merriman Market Analyst）是全球市场择时服务、产品和教育领域的领导者。

迄今为止，他们已经培训了约200名学生学习 MMA 市场分析和择时方法，其中优秀的毕业生已成为 MMA 的金融市场分析师。

---

### 总结

搜索结果中没有找到中文"评价"内容。总体来看，Raymond Merriman 在金融占星学和市场周期分析领域享有很高声誉，获得过多个行业终身成就奖，其著作在读者中评分较高，其市场分析服务被全球金融机构广泛使用。不过，需要注意的是，他的分析方法结合了占星学因素，这在主流金融界可能存在争议。

## Raymond Merriman（レイモンド・メリマン）について

### 人物概要
Raymond A. Merriman は The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. の社長であり、Merriman Market Timing Academy の創設者です。商品取引アドバイザー（CTA）、金融市場アナリスト、そして1982年以来、株式、金利、通貨、貴金属、原油、大豆を専門とする月刊マーケットアドバイザリーニュースレター「MMA Cycles Report」の編集者です。

### 著書のレビュー（Goodreads）
Goodreadsでは、Raymond Merriman の著書は平均評価 **4.19**（5点満点）で、26件の評価と2件のレビューが寄せられており、314回本棚に登録されています。

### 経歴・資格
- ミシガン州立大学で心理学の学士号を取得（1969年）。その後、ミシガン州立大学およびオークランド大学で心理学の大学院課程を修了（1969-1971年）。
- プロの占星術師としても知られており、1967年から占星術を研究し、1972年にAFA（アメリカ占星術師連盟）からプロ認定を取得しています。
- 1995年のUAC（統一占星術会議）でRegulus賞「占星術の職業イメージ向上」を受賞。2012年のUACではRegulus「生涯功労賞」を受賞しています。

### 主な著作
金融マーケットタイミングに関する複数の著書があり、『The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing』シリーズ（全5巻、1997-2012年）、『The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles』（1982年）、『The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market』（2006年）、そして毎年発行の『Forecast Book』（1976年以来）などがあります。

### 市場での評価
現在、何千人ものプロのトレーダーや個人トレーダーが彼の方法を活用しており、MMA（Merriman Market Analyst）はマーケットタイミングサービスの世界的リーダーとなっています。

これまでに約200名の学生がMMAの方法論を学び、トップ10名ほどが金融市場アナリストとして活躍しています。

### 金融業界での実績
1982年から1986年にかけてFNN（Financial News Network）に頻繁にゲスト出演。その後、Prudential Securities の投資顧問、E.F. Hutton（後のShearson Lehman Hutton）を経て、Paine Webber で小売商品先物部門の副社長を務めました。

## Merriman Market Analyst – Overview

Merriman Market Analyst provides tools that integrate a combination of cycles, geocosmic signatures, and trend analysis patterns to assist in interpretation of the various financial markets and the general economy.

Since 1982, Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) has extrapolated these patterns into proprietary financial forecasting tools that deliver results. The service has been featured in Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, and FX Street, and is described as the leader in market timing products and services.

## What MMA Offers

The service includes a weekly report that looks back at events in various stock and financial markets worldwide. Written from the perspective of a cycles analyst, Raymond Merriman educates on the relationship between Cycles, Geocosmic Signatures, and Trend Analysis patterns to interpret markets. Each week, the report identifies geocosmic factors in effect and shares his understanding of how these signatures may affect military, political, economic, and financial markets.

## Matrix Software Interview with Astrologer Ray Merriman

The search results reveal a notable interview conducted by Matrix Software with astrologer **Raymond A. Merriman**.

### Interview Details
The interview with astrologer Ray Merriman was published on April 1, 2001, and the interviewer was Clarke Fountain. It is hosted on the Matrix Software (astrologysoftware.com) website as part of their series of interviews with well-known astrologers.

### About Ray Merriman
Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., since 1981. He is the editor of the MMA Cycles Report and other advisory market reports used by traders and institutions all over the world. His free weekly market column is translated into 7 different languages.

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972. He is the author of *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope* (1977) and *The Solar Return Book of Prediction* (1977). At UAC 1995, he received the Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession," and at UAC 2012, he received the Regulus "Lifetime Achievement Award."

### Key Topics in the Interview

In the interview, Merriman was asked about the health and direction of the astrological community. He stated that he thinks astrology is getting increasingly healthy all the time, and that the quality of thought concerning grasp of the subject keeps getting better and better over the last 20 years or so, basing this on the quality of lectures he hears at major symposiums throughout the world.

He noted that the current generation of leaders in the astrological community started around the late 60s and early 70s, much like he did (his start was in 1967).

He suggested that astrology is at a point where it might be saturated with — or at least mature in its quest for — knowledge and technique, and instead the community is collectively moving towards more Saturnian things, like standards, ethics in practice, and accountability to clients within the context of a broader professional community. Many are now professionals, and the number of professionals has increased greatly.

Merriman also discussed his work on financial astrology, noting that he decided to leave as complete a study as possible of his understanding of the U.S. stock market, committing himself to researching all the cycles he could possibly find, and determining which astrological signatures had a correspondence with the greatest and smallest of all these cycles.

Then one day in 1994 he woke up and said it was time to start. He announced his retirement as Accounts Vice President of Retail Commodities at Paine Webber Securities and began writing books on market cycles and financial astrology.

### Additional Background
In conjunction with AstroCybernetics, Merriman also developed two financial astrological software systems: The FAR (Financial Astrological Research) program, and the SOS (Stock Optimizing Selector) Program, which enable traders to identify potential turning points in various stocks and/or financial futures markets.

His awards in astrology include: President of ISAR (1995–97); recipient of the 1995 UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image As a Profession"; recipient of the Aquarius Workshops Award for "Service To Astrology" (1994); and recipient of the Professional Astrologers Inc. (PAI) Award for "Outstanding Activities on Behalf of Furthering Goals of Astrology – Lectures."

The full interview is available at [astrologysoftware.com](https://astrologysoftware.com/m/community/interviews/ray_merriman.html).

The interview was published on **March 24, 2026**, on CanvasRebel Magazine's website. Here's a summary of the key points discussed:

### Background and Education
Merriman did his undergraduate and postgraduate work in Psychology at Michigan State University. During his last years there, he was introduced to astrology, which tied in well with his interest in psychology. He paid his way through school those last years by doing astrological consultations.

### Meeting Walter Bressert — A Turning Point
He had the good fortune to meet Walter Bressert, a world-renowned cycle's analyst and commodities trader, in 1980 while lecturing in Tucson, AZ. Bressert was interested in Merriman's research on financial markets related to astrological factors and offered to mentor him in cycle studies related to commodities over the next two years, which completely turned his life and business around.

### The Gold Book and Founding of MMA
This mentorship resulted in the publication of "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles," described as the first book ever on quantitative studies correlating cycle highs and lows in a financial market (Gold) to planetary cycles. This unexpected but fortunate meeting led to the founding of the Merriman Market Analyst Inc. and also led to immense interest in Financial Astrology, which became one of the hottest subjects in the field of astrology.

### Growth of MMA
Today, thousands of professional and independent traders use the methods developed in that book in developing their trading and investment plans, and MMA (Merriman Market Analyst) is the world leader in providing market timing services, products, and education.

### Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)
This eventually led to the creation of MMTA – the Merriman Market Timing Academy – in 2012, where his staff and himself personally train approximately 50 students (apprentices) over a 2-year training program to become exceptional financial market timing analysts. Today, they have trained approximately 200 students in the MMA methodology, and the top graduates now work as financial market analysts, covering not only stocks and precious metals markets but also currencies, grains, treasuries, and crypto.

### Motivation for Teaching
Merriman realized he needed to train others in the methodology he created if he wanted this knowledge to help others and not just disappear, which led to the idea for starting MMTA.

You can read the full interview at: [CanvasRebel – Meet Raymond Merriman](https://canvasrebel.com/meet-raymond-merriman/)

## Raymond Merriman on FXStreet

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst, Inc and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982.

### Recent Weekly Columns on FXStreet

Raymond Merriman publishes a regular weekly column on FXStreet through **The Merriman Market Analyst**. Here are some of his recent articles:

1. **"Crude Oil, the Strait of Hormuz, and the stalled recovery"** — published approximately 5 days ago
2. **"Why Crude Oil prices reveal the truth behind the fog of war"** — published approximately 12 days ago
3. **"Trading the whipsaws of Venus, Saturn, and Neptune"** — published approximately 19 days ago
4. **"The $10-billion question of tariff refunds"** — published approximately 26 days ago
5. **"Global extremes and the 'quiet' metal mania rebound"** — published approximately 32 days ago (via the Merriman Market Analyst page)
6. **"Saturn-Neptune and the end of the Dollar's 15-year bull cycle"** — published approximately 32 days ago
7. **"A 50-week cycle bottom and the lunar market launch"** — published about 1 month ago
8. **"Trade deals, market cycles, and planetary alignments"** — published May 11, 2025
9. **"The turbulent cosmic influence on Trump's presidency"** — published May 4, 2025

### About His FXStreet Column

The column is a free service, except in cases where a fee may be assessed to cover translation costs. The weekly report is written with the intent to educate the reader on the relationship between astrological factors and collective human activities as they are happening. Merriman approaches this from the perspective of a cycles analyst looking at the military, political, economic, and financial markets of the world.

### Background

Merriman is also well-known as a professional astrologer, having studied the subject since 1967, and receiving his professional certification from AFA (American Federation of Astrologers) in 1972. Between 1982–1986, he was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

## LeCochonSideral.info and Raymond Merriman's Weekly Column in French

The website **lecochonsideral.info** is a French-language site that hosts translations of Raymond Merriman's weekly financial astrology columns. Here's what the search revealed:

### About the Website
The site covers the Marché du Porc Breton (Breton Pork Market), pork prices, crude oil, Dollar-Yen forecasts, and MMA Cycles, including financial forecasts by R. Merriman.

### French Translations of MMA Weekly Column
The site publishes the weekly articles from MMA Cycles in French ("Les Articles hebdomadaires de MMA CYCLES en français"), with all weekly publications archived and classified by year, and the current week's column isolated in the menu for direct access.

To better understand Merriman's analyses, visitors are invited to the homepage of his site, which provides a summary of his publications translated into French. As for subscriptions, described as remarkably affordable, details are available on a dedicated page.

### Nature of the Free Column
The free financial astrology column for the week ahead is not the same as the subscription service titled "MMA Weekly Comments and Recommendations on Financial Markets."

It is a free service, except in cases where a fee may be assessed to cover the cost of translating the column from English into a non-English language. The weekly report is written to educate the reader on the relationship between astrological factors and collective human activities, often reporting what happened in various stock and financial markets throughout the world.

### About Raymond Merriman
Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter specializing in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and English.

The lecochonsideral.info website essentially serves as a French-language portal for Merriman's free weekly financial astrology commentary, making his market timing analysis accessible to French-speaking audiences.

## Raymond Merriman – Soular Wisdom Article

The main result comes from **Soular Wisdom** (soularwisdom.com), an astrological consulting and coaching site. The article is titled **"Market-timer Ray Merriman says a growing number of traders are looking to astrology for investment advice."**

Here are the key highlights:

### Background & Predictions
- As early as 1994, financial astrologer Ray Merriman began persistently warning anyone within earshot that a huge stock market decline and financial crisis would upset the global economic applecart in 2008.
- Merriman says his prediction was largely based on the angular relationship between transiting Saturn and Uranus – a 180-degree opposition aspect that would be forming in the heavens at this time.
- Merriman started calling the pending aspect the "Cardinal Climax," a phrase now commonly used by a growing legion of financial astrologers around the globe to describe this event.

### The Fed's Intervention
- Merriman admits he worried that "hard" or challenging aspects between slow-moving Saturn, Uranus and Pluto would be forming again in 2010 and 2014. The expectation was that more bad news might be on the way, but the largest market intervention in world history by central bank policymakers nullified this possibility. The Fed lowered interest rates and later began buying Treasuries and mortgage-backed securities in an effort to stimulate spending and economic growth, and with that help, the stock market was able to soar to record highs.

### Professional Credentials
- The author of nearly 50 books, Merriman writes the monthly Merriman Market Analyst newsletter (MMA Cycles) and both a weekly and daily forecast for more active traders. His life work has been divided about evenly between his role as a professional astrologer and accomplishments achieved in the more pragmatic world of business and investments.
- Merriman is a Commodity Trading Advisor (CTA) and passed both the Series 3 (Commodities) and Series 7 (Securities) exams while working as an analyst at E.F. Hutton in the 1980s.
- In his final Wall Street job he was Accounts Vice President of Retail Commodities Futures at Paine Webber.
- On the astrology side, Merriman passed the American Federation of Astrologers (AFA) professional astrology exam in 1972.
- He describes serving as President of the International Society for Astrological Research (ISAR) between 1994 and 2000 – and again between 2002 and 2008 – as high points in his career.

### Key Publications
- By 1977, he had written two well-received astrology books: *Evolutionary Astrology: The Journey of the Soul Through the Horoscope*, and *The Solar Return Book of Prediction*. The Solar Return book has become a standard in astrology with about 20 printings since it was first introduced.

### Awards
- In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

You can read the full article at: https://soularwisdom.com/2017/05/visual-composer-business-theme/

## Raymond A. Merriman – Financial Astrology Expert

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982.

### Background & Education
Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969, followed by post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University (1969–1971).

### Career Highlights
- He became a student of Walter Bressert, a legendary cycles analyst, and under his tutelage published "The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles" in 1982—the first book to show a quantitative research correlation between cycles in a financial market and cycles in the cosmos.
- Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).
- In 2013, he was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam as the "Best Market Timer of 2013," and he received the award again in 2014 for correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market.

### Books Available on Sacred Traders

1. **Basic Principles of Geocosmic Studies for Financial Market Timing** – In this book, you do not have to know everything about astrology; there are certain beginning principles in Financial Astrology that will be sufficient to increase your market timing skills, and the book covers the basic beginning principles necessary to get started.

2. **The Sun, The Moon and Silver Market: Secrets of a Silver Trader** – This book emphasizes that the most successful trading plans combine various factors, arguing that one technical or timing study must be supported by another, using studies like cycles, Gann, and geocosmics/astrology to define a "time band" in which a reversal of price is very likely.

3. **The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing** (5-volume series) – Written from 1997 through 2011, this series became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, comprising over 1,600 pages across 14 years.

4. In late 2015, his research on *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* was published.

His works are currently published in German, Italian, Dutch, French, Russian, Serbian, Czech, Vietnamese, Japanese, and English.

## Key Findings

### The Interview: Raymond Merriman & Claude Weiss in *Astrologie Heute*

A recording was made at the congress "Reset Astrology – Auftakt zu einer neuen Ära" on January 11–12, 2020 in Zürich, featuring an interview with Claude Weiss about Merriman's assessments on stock markets and a possible crash, published in *Astrologie Heute* Nr. 203, February/March 2020.

In that issue, Claude Weiss expanded his column on financial astrology, as it dealt with the important question of whether a larger crash on the stock markets was imminent, and if so, when.

### About Raymond Merriman

Raymond ("Ray") A. Merriman is a US-American psychologist and well-known financial astrologer, born on December 25, 1946, at 0:09 in Pontiac, Michigan. He earned a Bachelor's degree in Psychology from the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor in 1969 and discovered astrology in 1967 while working on his thesis about the formation of new subcultures, specifically the hippie movement. He was drawn especially to the works of Dane Rudhyar and Margaret Hone.

He became a specialist in financial astrology with a focus on stock market astrology, publishing the Merriman Market Analyst since 1981, and has written several books primarily on the topic. Like most stock market astrologers, he works with astrological cycles and rhythms, attempting to identify repeating patterns.

From 1995 to 2008, he was President of ISAR, one of the larger American astrologer associations. In 1995, he was honored with the prestigious Regulus Award for presenting a particularly professional image of astrology to the public.

### About Claude Weiss

Weiss is the owner of the astrological computer service Astrodata AG in Zürich (founded in 1978), President of the Swiss Astrologers' Association, and publisher of the largest German-language astrology magazine, *Astrologie Heute*.

Over 50 years of engagement with the astrology of current events and his regular articles in *Astrologie Heute* have made Claude Weiss one of the world's most well-known mundane astrologers.

### Their Professional Connection

Raymond Merriman is a prominent representative of the financial astrology community. As President and founder of Merriman Market Analyst (MMA), he has Wall Street experience, and his newsletter is "intensively used by banks, financial institutions, investors, and traders." Claude Weiss, founder of the Wettswil-based firm Astrodata, also works in service of MMA.

In collaboration with Astrodata, Merriman publishes a monthly German-language stock market newsletter alongside his numerous English-language publications.

## Raymond Merriman & Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) — Overview

Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil, and soybeans since 1982. He also writes a daily and weekly report for more active traders.

### Background & Education
Merriman's formal education includes a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology at Michigan State University in 1969. He did post-graduate studies in Psychology at Michigan State University and Oakland University, 1969–1971. His introduction to financial markets began as an apprentice to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst.

### Career History
Between 1982–1986, Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986–87), E.F. Hutton (later Shearson Lehman Hutton, 1987–1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990–1994).

### Books & Publications
Merriman is the author of several books on Financial Market Timing, including the series on *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, Volumes 1–5 (1997–2012); *The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles* (1982); *The Sun, Moon, and Silver Market* (2006); *Solar/Lunar Correlations to Gold Price Reversals: Secrets of a Gold Trader* (2015); and the annual *Forecast Book* (since 1976).

### Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA)
In 2013, he created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology. At present, several of the graduates are now market analysts with MMA, analyzing various international markets for "The MMA Cycles Report" as well as "The MMTA International Cycles Report" (ICR).

## About MMA

The Merriman Market Analyst was incorporated on September 28, 1983, at 2:30 PM, in Lansing, Michigan. The story of MMA began in 1980 in Tucson, Arizona when Raymond Merriman was introduced to Walter Bressert and began the study of cycles related to commodities and financial futures.

MMA combines decades of expertise with innovative tools to give investors a unique edge in navigating financial markets through market timing, geocosmic cycles, and technical analysis, providing resources and education to help traders make informed decisions.

Merriman currently resides in Cave Creek, Arizona, USA, and can be reached at ray@mmacycles.com or via the MMA website at www.mmacycles.com.

## Raymond Merriman & the Market Timing Digest Gold Star Award

### 2013 Gold Star Award
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. He was the only contestant (of twelve who were followed) to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. By contrast, the second-place finisher successfully identified 12.

### 2014 Gold Star Award
In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### Background on Raymond Merriman
Raymond A. Merriman is a market analyst and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, an advisory market letter issued 12 times per year, and used by financial institutions, investors, and traders throughout the world since 1981. He also issues a weekly and daily market report, with recommendations on the stock market, precious metals, currencies, crude oil, U.S. Treasuries, and grain markets.

Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

### Professional Background
Between 1982-1986, Raymond Merriman was a frequent guest contributor on the Financial News Network (FNN). He served as an Investment Executive with Prudential Securities (1986-87) and Shearson Lehman Hutton (1987-1990), before becoming an Accounts Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures with Paine Webber (1990-1994).

### Astrology & Awards
Raymond Merriman is well-studied in the field of Astrology. He is a Professional (Certified) Life Member of the American Federation of Astrologers (PLMAFA since 1972), as well as through ISAR, the International Society of Astrological Research (2000).

In 1995 he was the recipient of the UAC Regulus Award for "Enhancing Astrology's Image as a Profession." In 2012 he received the UAC "Regulus Lifetime Achievement Award," only the fourth person ever to receive this honor.

### Merriman Market Timing Academy
In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects identifying historical correlations between the analysis methods and historical performance. These courses are now available to new students for on-line learning.

## Raymond Merriman at Cosmic Patterns Convergence 2025

Raymond Merriman is a featured speaker at the Cosmic Patterns Convergence 2025, presenting on **"Financial Astrology and Its Importance in Market Timing."**

### About Raymond Merriman

He is the President of Merriman Market Analyst (MMA) Inc, described as the world leader in financial market timing products and services since 1981. Merriman's broader work for 2025 focuses on what he calls the "Aries Vortex." This unusual pattern holds the potential for important global changes for humankind and highlights the re-emergence of the United States as a world leader in today's techno-renaissance.

## Raymond Merriman's "Best Market Timer" Awards from Market Timing Digest

### 2013 Award
In early 2013, Merriman was awarded the Gold Star by Market Timing Digest of Amsterdam, Netherlands as the "Best Market Timer of 2013." He was the only contestant to successfully identify all 15 major turning points in the U.S. stock market by their criteria. By contrast, the second-place finisher successfully identified 12.

### 2014 Award
In 2014 Merriman received the Gold Star award again as "Best Market Timer of the Year" from Market Timing Digest, this time correctly identifying 20 of 21 reversal dates in the U.S. stock market well ahead of time.

### About Market Timing Digest
Market Timing Digest analyzes the subscription reports of 12 well-known Financial Astrologers, each month. At the end of the year, MTD announces those who made the most consistently correct calls, via the criteria set forth here. MTD is proud to present its list of "Best Market Timers for 2014." It beat the market 3 years from 2010-2012. The publication was based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, and operated from 2007 to 2015 (per the Schogt Market Timing website).

### About Raymond Merriman
Raymond Merriman is the President of the Merriman Market Analyst and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a registered Commodities Trading Adviser (CTA) with the National Futures Association. Raymond is a financial market analyst and has been the editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter, since 1982.

From 1997 through 2012, he wrote the five-volume series *The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing*, which became the basis for the curriculum used in MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy. In all, these books took 15 years to complete and comprise over 1600 pages.

In 2013, Raymond Merriman created MMTA, the Merriman Market Timing Academy, a two-year training course in Merriman's market analysis and market timing methodology developed over the past 40 years. Students took 99 classes in this two-year period, competency tests, and completed papers on seven major research projects identifying historical correlations between the analysis methods and historical performance. These courses are now available to new students for on-line learning.
